meaning: a. 引人动心的, 有魅力的;诱惑人的, 动人心的

examples.en: The warm, inviting library attracts students from every department.
examples.zh: 温馨宜人的图书馆吸引着各系学生。

meaning: adv. 安全地；安心地；牢固地；有把握地

examples.en: The package was securely strapped to the roof of the van.
examples.zh: 包裹被牢牢捆在货车顶上。

meaning: n. 严格, 严厉, 苛刻, 严酷, 严密, 精确;寒战, 强直, 僵硬

examples.en: The study's methodological rigor earned praise from external reviewers.
examples.zh: 该研究方法的严谨赢得了外部评审的称赞。

meaning: a. 自然而然的, 无意识的, 不知不觉的, 偶然的, 不随意的;不随意的

examples.en: Shivering is an involuntary response to sudden cold.
examples.zh: 颤抖是身体对骤冷的非自主反应。

meaning: a. 丑恶的, 可憎的, 令人沮丧的

examples.en: The plans revealed a hideous concrete block replacing the old theater.
examples.zh: 规划显示一栋丑陋的混凝土楼将取代老剧院。

meaning: n. 潦草的写法, 潦草写成的东西, 拙劣的作品;v. 潦草地书写, 乱写, 滥写

examples.en: Students scribble notes in the margins during the fast lecture.
examples.zh: 快节奏的课堂上,学生们在页边匆匆记笔记。

meaning: n. 精力, 活力, 耐力, 雄蕊;耐力, 精力; 雄蕊

examples.en: Marathon training gradually builds the stamina needed for race day.
examples.zh: 马拉松训练逐步积累比赛日所需的耐力。

meaning: n. 矛盾情绪;矛盾情绪(两种情感互相冲突)

examples.en: Her ambivalence about the promotion showed in every hesitant answer.
examples.zh: 她对升职的矛盾心态在迟疑的回答中显露无遗。

meaning: a. 有害的

examples.en: Excessive screen time can be detrimental to children's sleep.
examples.zh: 过长的屏幕时间可能损害儿童的睡眠。

meaning: n. 至高无上, 霸权地位, 优势, 至上;至高权力, 无上权力, 霸权

examples.en: The battle decided the naval supremacy of the entire region.
examples.zh: 这次海战决定了整个地区的海上霸权。

meaning: a. 不符合传统的, 非传统的

examples.en: The festival celebrates nontraditional instruments built from scrap metal.
examples.zh: 该音乐节礼赞用废金属打造的非传统乐器。

meaning: a. 有利的, 受惠的, 幸运的

examples.en: The favored candidate won the debate according to most analysts.
examples.zh: 多数分析师认为热门候选人在辩论中获胜。

meaning: n. 牧师

examples.en: The village clergyman recorded marriages in a leather-bound book.
examples.zh: 村里牧师把婚姻登记在一本皮面册子上。

meaning: vt. 散播, 传播, 宣传;vi. 广为传播

examples.en: The agency uses social media to disseminate public health updates.
examples.zh: 该机构利用社交媒体传播公共卫生信息。

meaning: n. 前奏, 序幕, 序诗, 前奏曲;vi. 作为前奏

examples.en: The short overture served as a prelude to the main opera.
examples.zh: 这首短小的序曲是整部歌剧的前奏。

meaning: n. 外交使节, 特使;使者, 代表, 使节

examples.en: The president sent a special envoy to the peace talks.
examples.zh: 总统派出特使参加和谈。

meaning: vi. 共存

examples.en: Farmers and wild elephants coexist uneasily along the reserve boundary.
examples.zh: 农民与野象在保护区边界不安地共存。

meaning: a. 不可信任的, 危险的, 背叛的, 不可靠的;奸诈的, 背叛的, 背信弃义的

examples.en: The mountain pass becomes treacherous after the first autumn snow.
examples.zh: 初雪过后,山口变得凶险异常。

meaning: n. 依附, 固执, 坚持;粘合

examples.en: Strict adherence to the recipe gives the bread its texture.
examples.zh: 严格遵守配方才能做出这种面包的口感。

meaning: n. 曳, 牵引, 牵引力;牵引

examples.en: The startup's electric scooters quickly gained traction in crowded cities.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司的电动滑板车在拥挤城市迅速走红。

meaning: a. 新闻业的, 新闻工作者的, 报刊特有的, 新闻工作的

examples.en: The article won praise for its rigorous journalistic standards.
examples.zh: 这篇文章因严谨的新闻标准受到称赞。

meaning: n. 灯塔

examples.en: The old lighthouse still guides ships past the rocky cape.
examples.zh: 老灯塔仍为船只指引绕过多礁的海角。

meaning: a. 侮辱的, 损害人体的

examples.en: He found the interviewer's questions deeply insulting and refused to continue.
examples.zh: 他觉得采访者的问题极具侮辱性,拒绝继续回答。

meaning: n. 卓越, 光辉;辉度

examples.en: The brilliance of the sunrise drew photographers to the cliff tops.
examples.zh: 日出的光辉把摄影者吸引到崖顶。

meaning: n. 象征, 徽章, 符号;vt. 用象征表示

examples.en: The maple leaf is the national emblem of Canada.
examples.zh: 枫叶是加拿大的国家象征。

meaning: n. 烽火, 灯塔;v. 照亮

examples.en: For lost sailors, the lighthouse served as a beacon of hope.
examples.zh: 对迷航的水手而言,灯塔是希望的明灯。

meaning: n. 照明, 阐明, 启发;照明, 映光

examples.en: The stained windows provide soft illumination for the evening service.
examples.zh: 彩绘窗为晚祷提供柔和的光线。

meaning: a. 同义词的, 同义的

examples.en: In local dialect, the old mill's name is synonymous with quality flour.
examples.zh: 在当地方言中,老磨坊的名字就是优质面粉的代名词。

meaning: a. 有生殖力的, 多产的, 丰富的;多育的, 多产的, 繁殖的

examples.en: The prolific author published three novels in a single year.
examples.zh: 这位多产作家一年内出版了三部小说。

meaning: n. 庄严, 伟大, 壮丽

examples.en: Tourists come to admire the faded grandeur of the imperial palace.
examples.zh: 游客前来欣赏帝国宫殿昔日的恢弘。

meaning: a. 有角的, 消瘦的, 有尖角的, 生硬的;角的, 角形的

examples.en: The museum's angular glass walls contrast with the brick neighborhood.
examples.zh: 博物馆棱角分明的玻璃墙与砖砌街区形成对照。

meaning: n. 外围, 边缘地区, 圆周;外周, 周围

examples.en: Affordable housing expanded rapidly on the periphery of the city.
examples.zh: 经济适用房在城市外围迅速扩展。

meaning: a. 动人的, 迷人的, 有魅力的

examples.en: The lecturer has an engaging style that keeps students attentive.
examples.zh: 讲师风格引人入胜,学生听得聚精会神。

meaning: n. (一)群, 游牧部落, 移动群;vi. 成群结队

examples.en: A horde of shoppers rushed through the doors on opening day.
examples.zh: 开业当天,一大群购物者冲进店门。

meaning: n. 大批的离去;退出, 大批离去, 成一外出

examples.en: The heat wave triggered an exodus of residents toward the coast.
examples.zh: 热浪引发居民大规模迁往海边。

meaning: a. 半透明的, 透明的

examples.en: The architect chose translucent panels to flood the stairwell with light.
examples.zh: 建筑师选用半透明板材,让楼梯间充满光线。

meaning: a. 有助于形成的, 造型的, 形成的;n. 构词要素

examples.en: Her formative years in the workshop shaped her approach to design.
examples.zh: 她在工坊度过的成长岁月塑造了她的设计理念。

meaning: n. 蛤, 沉默寡言的人;vi. 捞蛤

examples.en: The fisherman dug each clam from the wet sand at low tide.
examples.zh: 退潮时渔夫从湿沙中挖出一只只蛤蜊。

meaning: a. 惊人的, 惊险的

examples.en: The ridge trail offers breathtaking views of the glacier below.
examples.zh: 山脊小径可俯瞰下方冰川的壮丽景色。

meaning: n. 囚禁, 被关;囚禁, 被俘, 俘虏

examples.en: The pandas bred successfully after years of failed attempts in captivity.
examples.zh: 经过多年失败的尝试,大熊猫在圈养条件下成功繁殖。

meaning: a. 庆祝的, 喜庆的, 欢乐的

examples.en: Streets took on a festive mood before the national holiday.
examples.zh: 国庆之前,街道洋溢着节日的气氛。

meaning: a. 庄严的, 值得尊敬的

examples.en: The venerable university celebrated its eight hundredth anniversary this spring.
examples.zh: 这所古老学府今年春天庆祝了八百周年。

meaning: n. 微生物, 细菌;微生物

examples.en: A single microbe can multiply rapidly in warm food.
examples.zh: 单个微生物在温热的食物中能迅速繁殖。

meaning: a. 可折叠的;折叠; 折叠效应

examples.en: The design studio specializes in folding chairs for small apartments.
examples.zh: 设计工作室专门为小公寓设计折叠椅。

meaning: a. 毛绒绒的, 蓬松的, 空洞的, 无内容的, 不明确的;绒毛状的

examples.en: The baker topped the cake with fluffy cream and berries.
examples.zh: 面包师在蛋糕上缀以松软的奶油和浆果。

meaning: n. 宗派, 教派

examples.en: The sect settled in the valley during the seventeenth century.
examples.zh: 该教派于十七世纪在山谷定居。

meaning: n. 枞树, 杉木;枞木

examples.en: A tall fir sheltered the cabin from the north wind.
examples.zh: 一棵高大的冷杉为小屋挡住北风。

meaning: v. 挖空, 挖出, 凿通

examples.en: Archaeologists plan to excavate the buried temple next summer.
examples.zh: 考古学家计划明年夏天发掘被掩埋的神庙。

meaning: a. 会话的, 对话的, 健谈的;会话式的; 对话式的

examples.en: Her conversational style makes complex science easy to follow.
examples.zh: 她谈话式的讲解让复杂科学变得易懂。

meaning: n. 无差异, 同样, 划一, 一致;均匀性

examples.en: Critics complained about the uniformity of the new suburban houses.
examples.zh: 批评者抱怨新郊区住宅千篇一律。

meaning: a. 可仿效的, 可做模范的, 惩戒性的, 示范的;惩罚性的, 警戒性的, 示范的

examples.en: The officer received a medal for her exemplary conduct during the rescue.
examples.zh: 警官因救援中的模范表现获得奖章。

meaning: n. 苏格兰人, 苏格兰语, 刻痕;a. 苏格兰人的, 苏格兰语的

examples.en: The manager moved quickly to scotch rumors of further layoffs.
examples.zh: 经理迅速行动,平息了进一步裁员的传言。

meaning: a. 家长的, 族长的, 由族长统治的;家长的, 家长制的, 主教的

examples.en: The novel portrays a rigid patriarchal society in prewar village life.
examples.zh: 小说描绘了战前乡村森严的父权社会。

meaning: n. 传送者, 传达人, (疾病的)传播者;发散机; 发送器

examples.en: The radio transmitter sends weather alerts to fishing boats offshore.
examples.zh: 无线电发射台向海上渔船发送天气警报。

meaning: n. 步法, 步态;vt. 训练...的步法

examples.en: The injured athlete walked with an uneven gait after surgery.
examples.zh: 术后受伤运动员的步态不太平稳。

meaning: a. 古体的, 过时的, 古老的, 古代的;原始的, 古代的

examples.en: The law's archaic language confuses even experienced judges.
examples.zh: 这部法律陈旧的措辞连资深法官也感到困惑。

meaning: a. 熟练的, 老练的, 巧妙的;n. 能手, 内行

examples.en: The new intern is adept at managing conflicting schedules.
examples.zh: 新来的实习生善于协调相互冲突的日程。

meaning: vi. 侵略, 劫掠, 袭击;n. 侵掠, 侵略, 攻击

examples.en: The bakery made its first foray into wholesale supply this year.
examples.zh: 面包房今年首次涉足批发供应。

meaning: a. 旧式的, 落伍的, 过时的

examples.en: The hospital replaced its outdated scanning equipment last month.
examples.zh: 医院上个月更换了过时的扫描设备。

meaning: n. 说明者, 倡导者, 说明物, 指数;a. 说明的

examples.en: She is a leading exponent of plain language in legal writing.
examples.zh: 她是法律写作中使用平实语言的主要倡导者。

meaning: n. 鼻涕虫, 刺蛾, 懒汉, 弹丸, 金属小块, 重击;vi. 偷懒, 动作迟缓

examples.en: A single slug can destroy a row of seedlings overnight.
examples.zh: 一只蛞蝓一夜之间能毁掉一排幼苗。

meaning: n. 赞助, 主办, 保护

examples.en: The research was conducted under the auspices of the national academy.
examples.zh: 该研究在国家科学院的主办下进行。

meaning: n. 领土, 主权, 统治;统治权, 主权, 统治

examples.en: The treaty granted the crown dominion over the distant islands.
examples.zh: 条约授予王室对遥远群岛的统治权。

meaning: v. 破坏, 侵犯, 违反

examples.en: The court ruled the patent did not infringe the earlier design.
examples.zh: 法院裁定该专利并未侵犯在先设计。

meaning: a. 鼓舞人心的

examples.en: The paralyzed runner's comeback story was deeply inspiring to young athletes.
examples.zh: 瘫痪跑者复出的故事深深激励着年轻运动员。

meaning: n. 匕首;vt. 用剑刺

examples.en: A bronze dagger was unearthed beside the ancient warrior's remains.
examples.zh: 一把青铜匕首在古代武士遗骸旁出土。

meaning: a. 对角线的, 斜的, 斜纹的;n. 对角线, 斜线, 斜列

examples.en: A diagonal crack ran from the ceiling to the window frame.
examples.zh: 一道斜向裂缝从天花板延伸到窗框。

meaning: n. 黏合(性), 连贯性, 一致性;相干性

examples.en: The essay loses coherence whenever it jumps between unrelated examples.
examples.zh: 这篇文章在无关的例证之间跳转时逻辑涣散。

meaning: vt. 印, 铭刻;n. 印, 印记, 特征, 痕迹, 版本说明

examples.en: Fossils bear the imprint of leaves that fell millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 化石上印着数百万年前落叶的痕迹。

meaning: a. 扭歪的, 歪曲的, 歪斜的;v. 扭曲, 扭歪

examples.en: The columnist described the ceremony with her usual wry humor.
examples.zh: 专栏作家以她惯有的调侃口吻描述了典礼。

meaning: n. 烟碱, 尼古丁;烟碱; 尼古丁

examples.en: The patch releases small amounts of nicotine to ease cravings.
examples.zh: 贴片释放少量尼古丁以缓解烟瘾。

meaning: a. 古雅的, 离奇有趣的, 奇怪的

examples.en: Visitors love the quaint cottages that line the harbor road.
examples.zh: 游客喜爱海港路旁那些古雅的小屋。

meaning: n. 秧苗, 树苗;籽苗, 幼苗, 实生苗

examples.en: Each seedling is transplanted once it grows two true leaves.
examples.zh: 幼苗长出两片真叶后即行移栽。

meaning: n. 树脂;vt. 涂树脂于

examples.en: The pine tree's sticky resin slowly sealed the wound.
examples.zh: 松树黏稠的树脂慢慢封住了伤口。

meaning: vt. 宽恕, 赦免, 免除, 汇出, 缓解, 减轻, 把...提交, 使恢复原状, 推迟;vi. 缓解, 汇款

examples.en: The committee's remit covers only cases from the last decade.
examples.zh: 委员会的职权范围仅限近十年的案件。

meaning: a. 轶事的, 爱谈奇闻轶事的, 多轶事的

examples.en: Evidence for the remedy remains anecdotal rather than clinical.
examples.zh: 这种疗法的证据仍属轶闻而非临床数据。

meaning: a. 下流的, 不礼貌的;猥亵的

examples.en: The broadcaster was fined for airing indecent material before midnight.
examples.zh: 电视台因午夜前播放不雅内容被罚款。

meaning: n. 尊敬, 敬重, 敬礼, 尊严, 威望;vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬

examples.en: The monks greeted the ancient manuscript with quiet reverence.
examples.zh: 僧侣们怀着静默的敬意迎接这份古老手稿。

meaning: n. 障碍, 错误, 失败;vt. 阻止, 错过, 推诿

examples.en: Some investors balk at the high cost of the project.
examples.zh: 一些投资者因项目成本高昂而却步。

meaning: a. 萌芽的, 初期的, 未成熟;胚胎的

examples.en: The plan is still in its embryonic stage of development.
examples.zh: 该计划仍处于萌芽阶段。

meaning: a. 听得见的;可闻的

examples.en: A faint humming was audible whenever the machine started.
examples.zh: 机器一启动就能听到微弱的嗡嗡声。

meaning: vt. (使)分解, (使)碎裂;分解, 分裂, 蜕变

examples.en: The comet will gradually disintegrate as it approaches the sun.
examples.zh: 彗星接近太阳时会逐渐解体。

meaning: vt. 擦去, 冲刷(掉), 消灭, 忘掉, 盖销(邮票等);灭迹, 消灭, 涂抹

examples.en: The flood managed to obliterate every bridge across the valley.
examples.zh: 洪水冲毁了山谷里的所有桥梁。

meaning: vt. 使浸润, 使潜入, 使渗入;vi. 渗入

examples.en: Undercover officers infiltrate gangs suspected of smuggling antiques.
examples.zh: 便衣警察潜入涉嫌走私文物的团伙。

meaning: a. 预言性的, 成为前兆的

examples.en: The model showed strong predictive power for summer rainfall.
examples.zh: 该模型对夏季降雨显示出很强的预测能力。

meaning: vt. 质问, 讯问, 审问;vi. 质问, 讯问

examples.en: Detectives interrogate each witness separately to compare their accounts.
examples.zh: 侦探分开讯问每位证人以核对口供。

meaning: n. 个人主义, 个人特征;个人主义

examples.en: The course examines individualism in American literature and film.
examples.zh: 该课程探讨美国文学与电影中的个人主义。

meaning: n. 易接近, 可进入;可及性; 可达性; 可接近性; 吸湿性

examples.en: New ramps greatly improved accessibility at the train station.
examples.zh: 新坡道大大改善了火车站的无障碍通行。

meaning: n. 变化, 多样化;分散

examples.en: Economists urged diversification of exports away from raw minerals.
examples.zh: 经济学家敦促出口多元化,摆脱对原矿的依赖。

meaning: a. 不好不坏的, 通常, 平凡的

examples.en: The film received mediocre reviews despite its famous cast.
examples.zh: 尽管演员阵容强大,这部影片评价平平。

meaning: a. 气候的

examples.en: Scientists compared tree rings to reconstruct past climatic patterns.
examples.zh: 科学家对比年轮以重建过去的气候模式。

meaning: n. 斑点, 有斑点的东西, 污点, 缺点, 微粒, 肥肉;vt. 使有斑点

examples.en: A tiny speck of dust can ruin a silicon chip.
examples.zh: 一粒微尘就能毁掉一块硅芯片。

meaning: n. 译文, 施舍, 表演;生产量

examples.en: Her soulful rendition of the folk song moved the audience.
examples.zh: 她深情演绎的民谣打动了观众。

meaning: n. 柔软, 亲切, 柔和, 敏感, 易触痛;触痛

examples.en: He spoke about his late teacher with obvious tenderness.
examples.zh: 他谈到已故老师时满怀温情。

meaning: n. 求爱, 求婚, 求爱时期

examples.en: The peacock's vivid tail plays a key role in courtship.
examples.zh: 孔雀艳丽的尾羽在求偶中起关键作用。

meaning: n. 印度的种姓制度, (排他的)社会团体

examples.en: The scholar studied how caste shapes village politics today.
examples.zh: 学者研究种姓如何影响当今的乡村政治。

meaning: vt. 使中立, 使成中立地带, 使中和, 抵销;vi. 中立化, 变无效, 中和

examples.en: The antidote works to neutralize the venom within minutes.
examples.zh: 解毒剂可在几分钟内中和蛇毒。

meaning: n. 饲养者, 供给者, 奶瓶;给料器

examples.en: A wooden feeder hangs outside the kitchen window for birds.
examples.zh: 厨房窗外挂着一只喂鸟的木制食槽。

meaning: n. 传记作者

examples.en: Her biographer spent years reviewing letters in dusty archives.
examples.zh: 她的传记作者花多年查阅尘封档案中的信件。

meaning: n. 同时发生的事件;a. 同时发生的, 一致的

examples.en: The gallery hosted three concurrent exhibitions across its floors.
examples.zh: 美术馆各层同时举办三场展览。

meaning: n. 毛虫;履带车

examples.en: Each caterpillar transforms into a butterfly within the chrysalis.
examples.zh: 每条毛虫在茧中蜕变为蝴蝶。

meaning: vi. 呕吐, 喷涌;vt. 呕出, 喷

examples.en: The factory chimney used to spew thick smoke over the town.
examples.zh: 工厂烟囱曾向小镇喷吐浓烟。

meaning: a. 宏伟的, 庄严的

examples.en: The majestic whale surfaced beside the research boat at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,雄伟的鲸鱼在科考船旁浮出水面。

meaning: vt. 使混淆, 使狼狈, 挫败

examples.en: The survey results continue to confound the political analysts.
examples.zh: 民调结果仍令政治分析人士困惑不解。

meaning: vt. 使清洁, 净化, 使纯净;纯化, 净化, 精炼

examples.en: The ritual bath is meant to cleanse the worshipper's spirit.
examples.zh: 沐浴仪式旨在净化礼拜者的心灵。

meaning: vt. 没收, 把...充公, 查抄;a. 被没收的

examples.en: Teachers may confiscate phones that ring during examinations.
examples.zh: 考试期间手机响铃,教师可予以没收。

meaning: a. 厌恶的；厌烦的

examples.en: Viewers were disgusted by the footage from the illegal slaughterhouse.
examples.zh: 观众对非法屠宰场的画面深感厌恶。

meaning: n. 妨碍, 障碍, 阻止, 口吃;对履行义务的阻碍

examples.en: Poor roads remain the biggest impediment to rural development.
examples.zh: 道路落后仍是农村发展的最大障碍。

meaning: a. 电磁的, 由电磁石产生的;电磁的

examples.en: The antenna detects faint electromagnetic signals from distant galaxies.
examples.zh: 天线探测来自遥远星系的微弱电磁信号。

meaning: n. 自然主义者

examples.en: The young naturalist sketched every beetle he found in the forest.
examples.zh: 年轻的博物学者把森林里发现的甲虫一一画下。

meaning: a. 遵守纪律的；受过训练的

examples.en: A disciplined savings habit matters more than a high salary.
examples.zh: 有纪律的储蓄习惯比高薪更重要。

meaning: a. 喜不自禁的, 欢闹的, 引人发笑的

examples.en: The audience found the mayor's mistaken speech absolutely hilarious.
examples.zh: 观众觉得市长念错稿子的演讲十分滑稽。

meaning: vt. 包封, 遮盖, 包围;n. 信封

examples.en: Thick fog can envelop the airport and delay every flight.
examples.zh: 浓雾可能笼罩机场,使所有航班延误。

meaning: vt. 崇敬, 敬畏, 尊敬

examples.en: Local fishermen revere the sea as both provider and threat.
examples.zh: 当地渔民敬畏大海,它既是恩主也是威胁。

meaning: n. 钾;钾K

examples.en: Bananas are famous as a convenient source of potassium.
examples.zh: 香蕉是公认的方便补钾的食物。

meaning: n. 知识, 眼光

examples.en: The mountain lore of the guides dates back many generations.
examples.zh: 向导们的山地传说可追溯至许多代以前。

meaning: n. 箝口物, 箝制言论, 讨论终结;vt. 阻塞, 压制言论自由, 使窒息, 使呕吐, 插科打浑, 欺骗

examples.en: Parliament passed a law to gag officials speaking to reporters.
examples.zh: 议会通过法律禁止官员向记者发声。

meaning: vt. 发掘, 掘出, 从洞中赶出, 揭露, 发现

examples.en: Road workers unearth a Roman mosaic beneath the old square.
examples.zh: 道路工人在老广场下发掘出一幅罗马马赛克。

meaning: a. 矛盾的, 模棱两可的;矛盾情绪的

examples.en: Voters remain ambivalent about the proposed tax reform.
examples.zh: 选民对拟议的税改仍态度矛盾。

meaning: n. 口径, 才干, 水准;管径, 口径

examples.en: The program attracts applicants of remarkable academic caliber.
examples.zh: 该项目吸引学术水平出众的申请者。

meaning: n. 限制, 被禁闭, 分娩;分娩, 生产

examples.en: The animals showed stress after months of confinement in small cages.
examples.zh: 动物在狭小笼中关押数月后表现出应激。

meaning: n. 弹力, 弹性;弹性

examples.en: The new fabric combines warmth with remarkable elasticity.
examples.zh: 新面料兼具保暖性与出色的弹性。

meaning: n. 沉重的步伐, 长途跋涉;vi. 步履艰难地走, 蹒跚地走

examples.en: Rescuers had to trudge through deep snow to reach the climbers.
examples.zh: 救援人员不得不跋涉深雪去接应登山者。

meaning: v. 拾落穗, 收集

examples.en: Historians glean facts about daily life from household account books.
examples.zh: 历史学家从家庭账簿中搜集日常生活的史料。

meaning: a. 世间的, 世俗的, 世上的

examples.en: Her worldly experience made her a shrewd negotiator.
examples.zh: 丰富的世事阅历使她成为精明的谈判者。

meaning: vt. 藏起来;n. 隐藏处, 隐藏物

examples.en: Police found a stash of forged passports inside the van.
examples.zh: 警方在货车里发现一批伪造护照。

meaning: vt. 挡开, 回避, 闪避的回答;n. 挡开, 回避, 闪避的回答

examples.en: The minister tried to parry questions about the missing funds.
examples.zh: 部长试图避答关于失踪资金的提问。

meaning: a. 流出的, 射出的;n. 流出物, 由河湖等流出之水流

examples.en: The factory must treat its effluent before releasing it into the river.
examples.zh: 工厂排放废水入河之前必须先行处理。

meaning: n. 创办人, 家长, 元老, 教长, (天主教)教皇;家长, 族长, 创始人

examples.en: The family patriarch settled the dispute over the farmland.
examples.zh: 家族元老解决了农田纠纷。

meaning: vi. 吼叫, 怒骂, 缠结;vt. 咆哮着说, 搞乱, 使缠结

examples.en: Traffic began to snarl around the stadium hours before kickoff.
examples.zh: 开赛前几小时,体育场周边交通开始拥堵。

meaning: vt. 法律上认为正当, 使合法化;使合法化, 法律上认可, 使符法律

examples.en: Lawmakers will debate whether to legalize recreational cannabis next session.
examples.zh: 议员们将在下次会期辩论娱乐用大麻合法化。

meaning: n. 常绿树, 常绿植物;a. 常绿的

examples.en: The evergreen forest stays dark and green through the long winter.
examples.zh: 常绿林在漫长的冬季里依然苍翠。

meaning: vt. 吞, 大口大口地吸气, 吸收, 抑制;vi. 吞咽

examples.en: He finished the race and took a huge gulp of water.
examples.zh: 跑完比赛,他大口喝下一大口水。

meaning: n. 光辉, 壮丽, 显赫

examples.en: Restorers worked for years to revive the palace's original splendor.
examples.zh: 修复人员花多年恢复宫殿昔日的辉煌。

meaning: n. 漏斗, 漏斗状的东西, 烟囱;漏斗

examples.en: Storm clouds began to funnel into a rotating column.
examples.zh: 风暴云开始汇聚成旋转的漏斗状气柱。

meaning: n. 节制, 禁欲, 戒酒;节制, 禁戒(如禁酒,节欲)

examples.en: The doctor advised complete abstinence from alcohol during the treatment.
examples.zh: 医生建议治疗期间完全戒酒。

meaning: n. 翻译, 表现, 描写, 表演, 打底, 透视图

examples.en: The architect's digital rendering showed the lobby in warm daylight.
examples.zh: 建筑师的数字效果图展示了日光下的大厅。

meaning: n. 祖先, 世系, 名门出身

examples.en: DNA tests revealed traces of ancestry from three continents.
examples.zh: DNA检测显示出三大洲的血统痕迹。

meaning: a. 加快的;加速的

examples.en: The fellowship offers an accelerated path to a teaching license.
examples.zh: 奖学金项目提供了取得教师资格的加速通道。

meaning: n. 居民

examples.en: The average city dweller walks far more than suburban residents.
examples.zh: 城市居民的步行量远超郊区居民。

meaning: n. 野牛

examples.en: A herd of bison once roamed across the open plain.
examples.zh: 一群野牛曾漫步在开阔的平原上。

meaning: n. 生理学, 生理机能;生理学

examples.en: The course covers the physiology of exercise in remarkable detail.
examples.zh: 该课程详细讲解运动生理学。

meaning: vt. 举止, 驱逐出境;放逐, 驱逐, 递解

examples.en: The government moved to deport workers with expired visas.
examples.zh: 政府着手遣返签证过期的工人。

meaning: n. 狗舍, 狗屋, 阴沟;vt. 置于狗舍, 宿于狗舍

examples.en: The dog waited in its kennel for the morning walk.
examples.zh: 狗待在狗窝里等待晨间散步。

meaning: n. 震摇, 摇动, 颠簸;vi. 颠簸而行, 震摇

examples.en: The earthquake's first jolt knocked books from every shelf.
examples.zh: 地震的第一下震动把书架上的书全都震落。

meaning: a. 热心的, 激动的, 燃烧般的;灼热的; 热心的

examples.en: She is an ardent defender of the city's historic buildings.
examples.zh: 她是这座城市历史建筑的忠实捍卫者。

meaning: n. 百年纪念;a. 一百年的

examples.en: The town planned a parade for the college's centennial celebration.
examples.zh: 小镇为学院百年校庆安排了游行。

meaning: n. 希腊语的第三个字母(Γ,γ);γ(希腊文第三个字母), 丙种, 微克(千分之一毫克)

examples.en: Astronomers detected a burst of gamma rays from the dying star.
examples.zh: 天文学家探测到垂死恒星发出的伽马射线暴。

meaning: a. 虔诚的, 虔敬的, 诚恳的

examples.en: A devout pilgrim walks the ancient route every spring.
examples.zh: 一位虔诚的朝圣者每年春天都走这条古道。

meaning: n. 洞穴, 藏身处;vi. 掘洞穴, 躲藏

examples.en: Rabbits burrow beneath the meadow to escape the summer heat.
examples.zh: 兔子在草地下挖洞以躲避酷暑。

meaning: a. 听觉的, 听觉器官的;听的, 听觉的

examples.en: The device sends auditory signals directly to the inner ear.
examples.zh: 该装置将听觉信号直接传送至内耳。

meaning: n. 倾向, 爱好, 习性

examples.en: He shows a strong propensity for choosing risky investments.
examples.zh: 他表现出选择高风险投资的强烈倾向。

meaning: a. 盐的, 苦涩的, 由碱金属(或含镁之盐类)组成的;n. 盐湖, 盐田, 碱盐泻药, 生理盐水

examples.en: Nurses cleaned the wound with a mild saline solution.
examples.zh: 护士用温和的生理盐水清洗伤口。

meaning: a. 怪诞的, 可怕的, 离奇的, 神秘的

examples.en: The impersonator has an uncanny ability to mimic famous voices.
examples.zh: 那位模仿者模仿名人嗓音的能力出神入化。

meaning: a. 有抱负的, 有志气的

examples.en: The workshop offers aspiring writers a chance to meet editors.
examples.zh: 工作坊为有志写作的人提供与编辑见面的机会。

meaning: vt. 使喘不过气, 使窒息, 闷熄, 忍住, 抑制, 覆盖;vi. 窒息, 被抑制

examples.en: Bees can smother an invading hornet by forming a tight ball.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂能结成紧密的球团闷死入侵的胡蜂。

meaning: vt. 孵, 培养, 使发展;vi. 孵蛋, 潜伏, 筑巢, 孵化, 酝酿

examples.en: The hens quietly incubate their eggs for twenty-one days.
examples.zh: 母鸡会安静地孵蛋二十一天。

meaning: adv. 交替地, 间隔地

examples.en: The instructor spoke alternately in English and French throughout the seminar.
examples.zh: 讲师在研讨会中交替使用英语和法语。

meaning: a. 背的, 背部的, 背侧的;背的, 背侧的

examples.en: The shark's dorsal fin cut through the water at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,鲨鱼的背鳍划破水面。

meaning: a. 神话的, 存在于神话中的, 神话式的, 不真实的, 虚构的, 幻想出来的

examples.en: The valley is home to a mythical creature in local legend.
examples.zh: 在当地传说中,这个山谷栖息着一种神兽。

meaning: n. 神智健全, 头脑清楚, 通情达理;精神健全

examples.en: Walking in the park each evening preserved her sanity during exams.
examples.zh: 考试期间,每晚去公园散步让她保持了心智平和。

meaning: vt. 向...鼓吹革命, 使发生革命性剧变

examples.en: Cheap sequencing could revolutionize how doctors diagnose rare diseases.
examples.zh: 廉价测序可能彻底改变医生诊断罕见疾病的方式。

meaning: n. 猛犸, 庞然大物;a. 猛犸似的, 巨大的

examples.en: Workers unearthed a mammoth tusk while digging the new subway tunnel.
examples.zh: 工人挖掘新地铁隧道时挖出一根猛犸象牙。

meaning: n. 热情, 热心, 炽热

examples.en: The campaign inspired religious fervor among its youngest supporters.
examples.zh: 运动在最年轻的支持者中激起了宗教般的热情。

meaning: a. 掠夺成性的, 捕食生物的, 掠夺的;捕食的

examples.en: The lake's predatory fish keep the smaller species in check.
examples.zh: 湖中的掠食性鱼类控制着小型鱼类的数量。

meaning: n. 散播, 传播, 蔓延;扩散, 弥散, 漫射(光)

examples.en: The diffusion of printing technology transformed European society within decades.
examples.zh: 印刷技术的传播在数十年间改变了欧洲社会。

meaning: 重叠, 覆盖;重迭

examples.en: The two agencies have overlapping responsibilities for food safety.
examples.zh: 两家机构在食品安全上职责重叠。

meaning: n. 渗流, 分泌物;v. 渗出, 泄漏

examples.en: Mud pots ooze warm gray slime along the geothermal trail.
examples.zh: 泥浆泉沿着地热小径渗出温热的灰色黏泥。

meaning: a. 含有...的, 伴着...的, 充满...的

examples.en: The negotiation was fraught with risk for both companies.
examples.zh: 谈判对两家公司都充满风险。

meaning: a. 稀薄的, 微细的, 纤细的, 脆弱的;细薄的, 纤细的

examples.en: The link between diet and the disease remains tenuous.
examples.zh: 饮食与该疾病的关联仍然薄弱。

meaning: a. 不便的, 有困难的

examples.en: The train strike made the morning commute deeply inconvenient.
examples.zh: 铁路罢工让早晨通勤极为不便。

meaning: n. 突击, 猛击, 猛攻

examples.en: The ancient walls resisted the onslaught of invading armies.
examples.zh: 古城墙抵御了入侵军队的猛攻。

meaning: vt. 使蒸发, 使排出;vi. 蒸发, 散发, 泄露

examples.en: Investigators want to know what transpired during the closed meeting.
examples.zh: 调查人员想知道闭门会议期间发生了什么。

meaning: a. 商定的, 协定的, 一致的;一致的, 协力的, 共同的

examples.en: A concerted effort by neighbors saved the community garden.
examples.zh: 邻里齐心协力保住了社区花园。

meaning: n. 谷仓, 积蓄;vt. 储存, 贮藏

examples.en: The documentary managed to garner awards at three foreign festivals.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片在三个海外电影节上斩获奖项。

meaning: n. 墙面板, 小招牌

examples.en: Waves dragged the shingle back and forth along the shore.
examples.zh: 海浪把鹅卵石在岸边来回推移。

meaning: vt. 围绕, 使苦恼, 镶嵌

examples.en: The project was beset by delays and funding problems.
examples.zh: 项目受到延误和资金问题的困扰。

meaning: vi. 微微移动;vt. 推动

examples.en: The negotiators could not budge the minister from her position.
examples.zh: 谈判者无法让部长改变立场。

meaning: n. 粮草, 饲料, 搜寻粮草;vt. 喂, 掠夺, 搜寻粮秣

examples.en: Deer forage for food at the forest edge each dusk.
examples.zh: 每到黄昏,鹿群在林缘觅食。

meaning: vt. 使制度化, 使成为惯常的行为, 使一成不变, 把...送进疯人院

examples.en: Reformers hope to institutionalize the new voting procedures nationwide.
examples.zh: 改革者希望把新的投票程序制度化并推广全国。

meaning: a. 有日期的, 陈旧的

examples.en: The hotel's dated decor reminds guests of the 1970s.
examples.zh: 酒店陈旧的装潢让客人想起上世纪七十年代。

meaning: vt. 交付, 储蓄, 委托, 寄存;托卖, 寄存, 寄销

examples.en: The old ferry was consigned to the scrapyard last spring.
examples.zh: 老渡轮去年春天被送进了拆船场。

meaning: n. 实际性, 实用性, 实际事物

examples.en: Buyers praised the car's practicality rather than its styling.
examples.zh: 买家称赞的是这辆车的实用性,而非造型。

meaning: a. 有分歧的;散开的, 偏斜的

examples.en: The board reached divergent conclusions from the same market data.
examples.zh: 董事会从同一市场数据得出不同结论。

meaning: a. 笨重的, 麻烦的, 累赘的

examples.en: The cumbersome permit process discourages small businesses from expanding.
examples.zh: 繁琐的审批流程打消了小企业扩张的念头。

meaning: a. 未破损的, 未被征服的, 未打垮的, 不屈服的, 不涣散的, 整齐的, 未中断的;未被阻断的, 未破损的, 完好的

examples.en: The team's unbroken winning streak finally reached twenty games.
examples.zh: 球队不败连胜最终达到二十场。

meaning: n. 节流阀, 节气阀, 喉咙;vt. 扼喉咙, 使窒息, 压制, 使节流

examples.en: The pilot eased the throttle forward as the runway cleared.
examples.zh: 跑道清空之后,飞行员缓缓推大油门。

meaning: n. 甲烷, 沼气;甲烷; 沼气

examples.en: Melting permafrost releases methane into the atmosphere each summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天,融化的冻土向大气释放甲烷。

meaning: a. 悠闲的, 从容的;adv. 从容地, 悠闲地

examples.en: They enjoyed a leisurely breakfast on the hotel terrace.
examples.zh: 他们在酒店露台悠然地吃着早餐。

meaning: n. 提及, 暗指

examples.en: The poem contains a subtle allusion to a Greek myth.
examples.zh: 这首诗含蓄地化用了一则希腊神话。

meaning: n. 疑虑, 不安, 害怕, 担扰, 疑惧

examples.en: She signed the contract despite a lingering misgiving about the terms.
examples.zh: 尽管对条款心存疑虑,她还是签了合同。

meaning: a. 残忍的, 凶猛的, 可怕的

examples.en: A ferocious storm battered the fishing fleet for two days.
examples.zh: 猛烈的风暴连续两天袭击渔船队。

meaning: vt. 恢复原状, 修复, 使康复;恢复, 使恢复心理健康, 修复

examples.en: The center helps rehabilitate injured birds before releasing them.
examples.zh: 该中心帮助受伤的鸟康复后再放飞。

meaning: a. 地震的

examples.en: The region installed new sensors to measure seismic activity.
examples.zh: 该地区安装了新传感器以测量地震活动。

meaning: a. 问候的, 称赞的, 夸奖的

examples.en: The hotel offers complimentary breakfast for guests arriving before noon.
examples.zh: 酒店为中午前抵达的客人提供免费早餐。

meaning: a. 寒冷的, 严寒的, 冷淡的;寒冷的, 冷淡的, 性感缺失的

examples.en: Frigid winds swept down from the mountains all weekend.
examples.zh: 整个周末,寒冷的山风呼啸而下。

meaning: n. 少量食物, 细咬, 轻咬, 啃;v. 一点一点地咬, 细咬, 吹毛求疵

examples.en: Rabbits nibble the lettuce leaves down to the stalk.
examples.zh: 兔子把生菜叶啃得只剩菜梗。

meaning: a. 有魄力的, 有进取心的, 有事业心的

examples.en: An enterprising student launched a bike repair service on campus.
examples.zh: 一名富有创业精神的学生在校园开办了修车服务。

meaning: n. 涌出, 滔滔不绝地讲话;v. 涌出, 迸出, 滔滔不绝的讲话

examples.en: Oil began to gush from the broken pipeline into the field.
examples.zh: 石油开始从破裂的管道涌进田地。

meaning: vt. 厌恶, 憎恶

examples.en: Many commuters loathe the crowded evening trains in summer.
examples.zh: 许多通勤者厌恶夏日拥挤的晚班列车。

meaning: a. 无懈可击的, 勿容置疑的, 无瑕疵的, 不会做坏事的

examples.en: The waiter's impeccable manners impressed even the exacting chef.
examples.zh: 侍者无可挑剔的举止连苛刻的主厨也为之侧目。

meaning: a. 语调强的, 着重的, 强调了的

examples.en: The judges gave an emphatic rejection to the appeal.
examples.zh: 法官们对这项上诉予以断然驳回。

meaning: vi. 减去, 贬低;vt. 转移, 分散

examples.en: Constant interruptions detract from the quality of online classes.
examples.zh: 频繁的干扰会降低网课的质量。

meaning: n. 路障, 障碍;vt. 设路障于, 阻碍

examples.en: Protesters built a barricade across the entrance to the square.
examples.zh: 抗议者在广场入口设置了路障。

meaning: n. 生态学者

examples.en: The ecologist tracks otter populations along the polluted river.
examples.zh: 生态学家追踪受污染河流沿岸的水獭种群。

meaning: a. 从事颠覆的, 破坏性的;n. 破坏分子, 颠覆分子

examples.en: The regime banned the novel as subversive literature.
examples.zh: 当局以颠覆性文学为由查禁了这部小说。

meaning: n. 污点, 耻辱, 感染;vt. 污染, 使腐败, 沾染, 腐蚀

examples.en: The scandal threatened to taint the whole research team.
examples.zh: 丑闻可能玷污整个研究团队的声誉。

meaning: a. 未被扰乱的, 安静的, 镇定的

examples.en: The rare plants thrive in this undisturbed corner of the marsh.
examples.zh: 珍稀植物在沼泽这片无人打扰的角落繁茂生长。

meaning: a. 知觉的, 有知觉力的, 感知的;知觉的

examples.en: Her perceptive comments revealed flaws nobody else had noticed.
examples.zh: 她敏锐的点评揭示了别人都没注意到的问题。

meaning: n. 埋伏, 伏兵, 伏击;vt. 埋伏, 伏击

examples.en: The patrol narrowly escaped an ambush near the mountain pass.
examples.zh: 巡逻队在山口附近险遭伏击。

meaning: n. 先驱, 前兆

examples.en: This simple machine was the forerunner of the modern computer.
examples.zh: 这台简单的机器是现代计算机的雏形。

meaning: n. 顺从, 尊重

examples.en: The young officer treated the veteran inspector with obvious deference.
examples.zh: 年轻警官对资深督察明显恭敬有加。

meaning: n. 福佑, 天赐的福;实现系统软件的基本语言

examples.en: Sitting by the lake in silence was pure bliss for him.
examples.zh: 对他而言,静坐湖边便是纯粹的幸福。

meaning: a. 看得清的, 可看出的, 可辨别的, 辨别得出的;可识别的

examples.en: There was no discernible difference between the two designer samples.
examples.zh: 两个设计师样品之间看不出明显差别。

meaning: a. 不能想象的, 想不到的, 难信的

examples.en: A century ago, instant global communication seemed utterly inconceivable.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前,即时全球通信似乎完全不可想象。

meaning: n. 损害, 损害物;损害, 伤害, 危害

examples.en: He worked overtime to the detriment of his health.
examples.zh: 他长期加班,以致损害了健康。

meaning: vt. 解散, 遣散;vi. 被解散

examples.en: The committee voted to disband after twenty years of service.
examples.zh: 委员会服务二十年后投票决定解散。

meaning: vt. 推翻, 颠覆, 毁灭;颠覆, 推翻, 减亡

examples.en: The satire uses humor to subvert official propaganda.
examples.zh: 这部讽刺作品用幽默颠覆官方宣传。

meaning: vt. 弥漫于, 遍及于, 流行于, 蔓延, 渗透于, 充满

examples.en: A sense of loss seemed to pervade the empty campus.
examples.zh: 空荡的校园里弥漫着一种失落感。

meaning: n. 民俗学, 民间风俗, 民间传说

examples.en: Local folklore describes a spirit that guards the mountain spring.
examples.zh: 当地民间传说讲述一位守护山泉的神灵。

meaning: a. 严峻的, 可怕的, 令人难亲近的

examples.en: The cliff presents a forbidding wall of black rock.
examples.zh: 悬崖如一道狰狞的黑色岩壁。

meaning: n. 荨麻;vt. 以荨麻刺, 激怒

examples.en: The mayor finally decided to grasp the nettle of pension reform.
examples.zh: 市长终于下定决心啃下养老金改革的硬骨头。

meaning: n. 逃避, 藉口;回避, 规避, 逃避

examples.en: The tycoon was jailed for years of tax evasion.
examples.zh: 这位大亨因多年逃税而锒铛入狱。

meaning: n. 爱好, 嗜好

examples.en: She has a penchant for collecting vintage travel posters.
examples.zh: 她酷爱收集复古旅行海报。

meaning: vt. 诱拐, 绑架, 使外展;外展, 展

examples.en: Detectives foiled a plot to abduct the wealthy heiress.
examples.zh: 警方挫败了一起绑架富家女继承人的阴谋。

meaning: n. 恩惠

examples.en: The new bridge is a boon for commuters on both banks.
examples.zh: 新大桥是两岸通勤者的福音。

meaning: vt. 再磨光, 刷新

examples.en: Workers will refurbish the theater during the summer closure.
examples.zh: 工人将在夏季歇业期间翻修剧院。

meaning: n. 借口, 虚假, 伪装

examples.en: He visited the office under the pretense of checking the accounts.
examples.zh: 他借口查账来到办公室。

meaning: vt. 分配, 分摊指定;(按股或按规定)分配, 配(拨)给, 规(派)定

examples.en: The school will allot more time to science in the timetable.
examples.zh: 学校将在课表中给科学课分配更多时间。

meaning: vi. 落下, 偶然发现;a. 点着的

examples.en: Sparrows alight on the fence each time the farmer scatters grain.
examples.zh: 农夫一撒谷子,麻雀便落上栅栏。

meaning: n. 微生物, 微小动植物;微生物

examples.en: Scientists found a new microorganism deep beneath the polar ice.
examples.zh: 科学家在极地冰层深处发现一种新的微生物。

meaning: a. 成斜坡的, 倾斜的

examples.en: The cottage sits on a sloping meadow above the village.
examples.zh: 小屋坐落在村庄上方倾斜的草地上。

meaning: a. 敏锐的, 尖锐的, 伸入很深的, 了解透彻的;穿透的

examples.en: The reporter asked a penetrating question about the missing documents.
examples.zh: 记者就失踪文件提出一针见血的疑问。

meaning: a. 消耗的, 枯竭的, 彻底的, 详尽的

examples.en: The committee conducted an exhaustive review of every safety report.
examples.zh: 委员会彻底审查了每一份安全报告。

meaning: n. 大屠杀, 残杀

examples.en: Reports described the carnage left by the retreating armies.
examples.zh: 报道描述了撤退军队留下的杀戮场面。

meaning: n. 接合, 连接, 接缝

examples.en: The project has reached a critical juncture in its development.
examples.zh: 项目的发展已到关键时刻。

meaning: n. 净化, 清除, 泻药;v. (使)净化, 清除, (使)通便

examples.en: The new director began to purge the department of corruption.
examples.zh: 新任主管开始整顿部门里的腐败。

meaning: n. 迷宫, 难解事物, 迷路;迷宫; 曲径

examples.en: Tourists get lost in the labyrinth of narrow medieval streets.
examples.zh: 游客在中世纪狭窄街巷的迷宫中迷路。

meaning: a. 触染性的, 会蔓延的;(接)触(传)染的

examples.en: Laughter proved contagious as the ceremony dissolved into giggles.
examples.zh: 笑声具有感染力,典礼在咯咯笑声中落幕。

meaning: a. 重大的, 重要的

examples.en: The signing was a momentous day in the nation's history.
examples.zh: 签署之日是国家历史上的重大时刻。

meaning: a. 乌托邦的, 空想社会主义的;n. 理想社会主义者

examples.en: Critics dismissed the plan as utopian and financially impossible.
examples.zh: 批评者斥该计划为空想,财政上根本行不通。

meaning: a. 自传的, 自传体的

examples.en: Her autobiographical novel draws heavily on her childhood in Wales.
examples.zh: 她的自传体小说大量取材于她在威尔士的童年。

meaning: a. 岔恨的, 易怨恨的, 不满的, 显然不满的

examples.en: The staff grew resentful of the unequal distribution of bonuses.
examples.zh: 员工对奖金分配不均日益不满。

meaning: a. 易坏的, 脆弱的, 浅薄的;n. 易损坏的东西(或材料), 薄纸, 描图用薄纸, 薄纸稿纸

examples.en: The tent's flimsy poles snapped in the first strong gust.
examples.zh: 帐篷单薄的撑杆在第一阵强风中就断了。

meaning: a. 费解的, 谜一般的, 高深莫测的

examples.en: The gallery's centerpiece is an enigmatic portrait of a veiled woman.
examples.zh: 展厅的核心是一幅神秘莫测的戴纱女子肖像。

meaning: a. 沉闷的

examples.en: Weeks of dreary rain dampened the town's summer festival.
examples.zh: 连绵阴雨浇灭了小镇夏日节的兴致。

meaning: n. 自负, 骄傲, 主张

examples.en: The bistro serves excellent food without any pretension.
examples.zh: 这家小餐馆的食物极好,毫无做作之气。

meaning: n. 周围, 社会环境, 环境, 表达的手法;环境

examples.en: The novel captures the artistic milieu of Paris in the 1920s.
examples.zh: 小说捕捉到二十世纪二十年代巴黎的艺术圈氛围。

meaning: adv. 照惯例, 照常套, 照老例

examples.en: The building looks conventionally modern until you notice the roof garden.
examples.zh: 这栋楼看起来是寻常的现代风格,直到你注意到屋顶花园。

meaning: a. 朦胧的, 模糊的, 烟雾弥漫的

examples.en: The skyline stood hazy behind a curtain of summer smog.
examples.zh: 夏季烟雾如幕,天际线一片朦胧。

meaning: a. 像玻璃的；光滑的；上过釉的；呆滞无神的

examples.en: The pottery studio is known for its deep blue glazed bowls.
examples.zh: 陶艺工作室以深蓝色的釉碗闻名。

meaning: n. 赔偿, 补救, 矫正;vt. 纠正, 赔偿, 救济

examples.en: Victims of the scandal are seeking legal redress in court.
examples.zh: 丑闻的受害者正寻求法庭上的法律救济。

meaning: a. 羊毛制的, 模糊的, 似羊毛的, 蓬乱的

examples.en: She wore a thick woolly scarf against the mountain wind.
examples.zh: 她围着厚厚的羊毛围巾抵御山风。

meaning: n. 非凡的领导力, 神秘的个人魅力, 神授的能力

examples.en: The candidate's charisma drew crowds that filled the stadium.
examples.zh: 候选人的个人魅力吸引了满场的人群。

meaning: n. 全体, 总数, 全食

examples.en: Astronomers traveled far to observe the eclipse in its totality.
examples.zh: 天文学家远赴观测日全食的完整过程。

meaning: n. 创意, 新奇, 独创能力, 原始

examples.en: The judges praised the young composer's bold originality.
examples.zh: 评委称赞年轻作曲人大胆的独创性。

meaning: a. 偏僻的, 迂回的

examples.en: The villain uses devious schemes to seize the family fortune.
examples.zh: 反派用阴险的计谋夺取家族财产。

meaning: a. 能得到的

examples.en: Fresh tropical fruit was rarely obtainable in northern towns.
examples.zh: 在北方小镇,新鲜热带水果曾经难得一见。

meaning: a. 有益的, 增进知识的

examples.en: The failure of the first launch proved highly instructive.
examples.zh: 首次发射的失败具有极大的借鉴意义。

meaning: vi. 憔悴, 凋萎, 苦思

examples.en: Small farms continue to languish while demand for imports rises.
examples.zh: 进口需求上升之际,小农场依旧萎靡不振。

meaning: vi. 晒太阳, 感到舒适

examples.en: Seals bask on the rocks when the tide falls each afternoon.
examples.zh: 每天下午退潮时,海豹趴在礁石上晒太阳。

meaning: a. 消化的, 助消化的;n. 助消化药

examples.en: Fiber plays an essential role in keeping the digestive system healthy.
examples.zh: 纤维对保持消化系统健康至关重要。

meaning: a. 附加的；依恋的, 充满爱心的

examples.en: The garage is attached to the house by a short covered walkway.
examples.zh: 车库通过一条带顶的通道与房子相连。

meaning: vt. 浪费, 使分散;vi. 浪费, 漂泊, 四散

examples.en: The team squandered a two-goal lead in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 球队在最后时刻浪费了两球领先的优势。

meaning: n. 遗忘, (头脑的)一片空白状, 湮没, 大赦, 赦免;忘却, 被忘却的事, 大赦

examples.en: The poet's works sank into oblivion for nearly a century.
examples.zh: 诗人的作品湮没无闻近一个世纪。

meaning: a. 不同的, 相异的

examples.en: The twins' tastes are not dissimilar, despite their different careers.
examples.zh: 尽管职业不同,这对双胞胎的品味并非全然不同。

meaning: a. 不可逆的, 不可改变的, 不能倒置的, 不能翻转的, 不能倒转的, 不可撤销的;不可逆的

examples.en: Scientists warn the damage to the reef may be irreversible.
examples.zh: 科学家警告珊瑚礁的破坏可能不可逆转。

meaning: n. 海狸(毛皮);轻型及中型飞机加油

examples.en: A beaver dam has transformed the small stream into a pond.
examples.zh: 海狸坝把小溪改造成一片池塘。

meaning: a. 卫生的;n. 公共厕所

examples.en: Inspectors closed the kitchen for violating basic sanitary standards.
examples.zh: 检查员以违反基本卫生标准为由查封了厨房。

meaning: a. 主要的, 最初的, 原始的

examples.en: The storm awakened a primal fear of the open sea.
examples.zh: 风暴唤起了对茫茫大海的原始恐惧。

meaning: v. 使汞齐化, 合并

examples.en: The two regional banks plan to amalgamate next fiscal year.
examples.zh: 两家地区银行计划在下一财年合并。

meaning: adv. 微暗, 朦胧

examples.en: The chapel was dimly lit by candles along the walls.
examples.zh: 小教堂仅靠墙边的蜡烛发出微光。

meaning: a. 义务的, 必须的, 强制性的;有拘束的, 强制的, 必须的

examples.en: Wearing a helmet is obligatory for all cyclists on this road.
examples.zh: 在这条路上骑车必须佩戴头盔。

meaning: adv. 适当地, 适宜地

examples.en: The bridge is aptly named after the engineer who saved it.
examples.zh: 这座桥以挽救它的工程师命名,恰如其分。

meaning: n. 赎金, 赎身, 赎回;vt. 赎, 赎身, 赎回, 勒索赎金

examples.en: The kidnappers demanded a ransom before releasing the journalist.
examples.zh: 绑匪索要赎金后才肯释放记者。

meaning: n. 教条

examples.en: The academy encouraged inquiry rather than acceptance of dogma.
examples.zh: 学院鼓励探究,而非盲从教条。

meaning: a. 星际的

examples.en: The probe carries a message for any interstellar travelers who find it.
examples.zh: 探测器携带了给可能发现它的星际旅者的讯息。

meaning: vt. 施催眠术, 迷住, 迷惑;催眠

examples.en: The northern lights seemed to mesmerize everyone standing in the snow.
examples.zh: 北极光仿佛让雪中的每个人都看得入迷。

meaning: v. 拖, 拉;n. 一拖, 一拉, 耳朵, 耳状物, 装腔作势, 勒索

examples.en: He had to lug two heavy suitcases up five flights.
examples.zh: 他不得不提着两只沉重的箱子爬五段楼梯。

meaning: vi. 自制, 戒绝, 弃权, 回避

examples.en: Three council members chose to abstain from the final vote.
examples.zh: 三名议员在最终表决中选择弃权。

meaning: a. 沉默寡言的, 不苟言笑的, 缄默的

examples.en: There was a tacit agreement never to discuss the old lawsuit.
examples.zh: 大家心照不宣,从不提及那桩旧诉讼。

meaning: vi. 伸出, 突出;vt. 使伸出, 使突出

examples.en: Rusty nails protrude from the old fence near the playground.
examples.zh: 游乐场旁的旧栅栏上突出着生锈的钉子。

meaning: a. 令人喜欢的, 使人愉快的, 爽快的

examples.en: Riding the mountain trail at sunrise was absolutely exhilarating.
examples.zh: 日出时分骑行走山径令人无比畅快。

meaning: n. 英勇, 勇敢事迹, 豪侠行为

examples.en: The medal honors the firefighter's heroism during the warehouse blaze.
examples.zh: 这枚奖章表彰消防员在仓库大火中的英勇。

meaning: v. 呼气, 发出, 散发

examples.en: The diver must exhale slowly while rising toward the surface.
examples.zh: 潜水员向水面上升时必须缓慢呼气。

meaning: a. 惰性的, 迟钝的, 无活力的, 呆滞的;惰性的, 无作用的, 无效的

examples.en: The gas is chemically inert and safe inside the bulbs.
examples.zh: 这种气体化学性质不活泼,在灯泡中很安全。

meaning: a. 流产的, 堕胎的, 失败的;流产的; 顿挫的

examples.en: The rebels' abortive uprising collapsed within a single chaotic day.
examples.zh: 叛乱分子流产的起义在混乱的一天内瓦解。

meaning: n. 氦;氦

examples.en: Party balloons float because helium is lighter than air.
examples.zh: 派对气球能飘起来,因为氦比空气轻。

meaning: vt. 弄皱, 压皱;vi. 崩溃, 变皱

examples.en: He watched his lottery ticket crumple in the rain.
examples.zh: 他眼睁睁看着彩票在雨中皱成一团。

meaning: n. 磨损, 打架, 争论;vt. 使磨损

examples.en: Tempers began to fray as the delay stretched into hours.
examples.zh: 延误拖到数小时,大家的火气渐渐上来。

meaning: n. 白蚁

examples.en: A termite colony can silently hollow out wooden beams.
examples.zh: 白蚁群能悄无声息地蛀空木梁。

meaning: a. 基本的, 起码的, 初步的, 发展不完全的, 残留的, 退化的;原基的, 未成熟的; 残遗的, 已退化的

examples.en: The island clinic has only rudimentary equipment for surgery.
examples.zh: 岛上诊所只有最基本的手术设备。

meaning: v. 解剖, 切开

examples.en: Biology students dissect a frog to study its organs.
examples.zh: 生物课上学生解剖青蛙以研究其器官。

meaning: n. 深渊, 深邃, 地狱

examples.en: The village sits at the edge of a vast rocky abyss.
examples.zh: 村庄坐落在巨大的岩石深渊边缘。

meaning: a. 偷偷摸摸的;秘密的, 暗中的

examples.en: The resistance held clandestine meetings in the bakery cellar.
examples.zh: 抵抗组织在面包房的地窖里秘密集会。

meaning: n. 军备, 军队, 武器;武器

examples.en: The treaty limits each nation's naval armament in the region.
examples.zh: 条约限制各国在该地区的海军军备。

meaning: vt. 引诱, 吸引;n. 魅力, 诱惑力

examples.en: The allure of easy money drew thousands to the mining town.
examples.zh: 快钱的诱惑把数千人吸引到采矿小镇。

meaning: a. 难控制的, 无法无天的, 任性的

examples.en: The teacher struggled to calm the unruly class after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后老师努力让吵闹的班级安静下来。

meaning: vt. 避开, 远避

examples.en: Careful writers eschew jargon when addressing the general public.
examples.zh: 严谨的作者面向大众写作时避免使用行话。

meaning: vi. 制定法律;vt. 用立法规定

examples.en: Parliament declined to legislate on the contentious hunting issue.
examples.zh: 议会拒绝就充满争议的狩猎问题立法。

meaning: 唯一性

examples.en: The museum protects the uniqueness of the island's folk culture.
examples.zh: 博物馆守护着岛屿民俗文化的独特性。

meaning: a. 英勇的, 壮丽的, 华丽的

examples.en: The gallant officer carried two children through the smoke.
examples.zh: 英勇的军官抱着两个孩子穿过浓烟。

meaning: n. 共犯, 同谋;协同菌

examples.en: Police arrested the thief and his accomplice within hours.
examples.zh: 警方数小时内便抓获小偷及其同伙。

meaning: vt. 绕行, 陷害, 包围, 智取

examples.en: Lawyers found a way to circumvent the strict export ban.
examples.zh: 律师找到了绕过严格出口禁令的办法。

meaning: vi. 干预, 拨弄, 贿赂, 损害, 篡改;vt. 篡改

examples.en: Officials warned tenants not to tamper with the smoke alarms.
examples.zh: 官员警告住户不要擅自改动烟雾报警器。

meaning: n. 自然资源保护论者

examples.en: The conservationist fought for years to protect the wetland.
examples.zh: 环保人士为保护这片湿地奋斗多年。

meaning: n. 压缩, 凝缩, 冷凝;冷凝; 冷凝作用; 缩合; 缩合作用; 凝聚; 凝聚作用; 凝结作用

examples.en: Condensation formed on the cold window before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出之前,冰凉的窗玻璃上凝起了水汽。

meaning: n. 背诵, 吟诵, 详述;叙述, 评述, 列举

examples.en: The piano students gave a short recital for their parents.
examples.zh: 钢琴学生为家长们举行了简短的演奏会。

meaning: n. 洋李, 李子干, 深紫红色, 傻瓜;vt. 修剪, 砍掉, 删除

examples.en: Gardeners prune the rose bushes every year in late winter.
examples.zh: 园丁每年冬末修剪玫瑰。

meaning: n. (建筑物的)砖石部分

examples.en: Skilled workers restored the crumbling masonry of the cathedral tower.
examples.zh: 技工修复了大教堂塔楼破碎的砖石。

meaning: a. 强制的, 强迫的;强迫性的

examples.en: His compulsive checking of email began to affect his sleep.
examples.zh: 他强迫性查邮件的习惯开始影响睡眠。

meaning: n. 批发商;批发商

examples.en: The shop buys coffee beans directly from a regional wholesaler.
examples.zh: 商店直接从地区批发商采购咖啡豆。

meaning: a. 手术后的;手术后的

examples.en: Nurses monitor postoperative patients closely during the first night.
examples.zh: 护士在术后首夜密切观察病人。

meaning: a. 易怒的, 急躁的;应激性的, 过敏的

examples.en: Lack of sleep made the usually calm doctor irritable.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让平时冷静的医生变得易怒。

meaning: a. 舒适的, 温暖的, 整洁的, 紧身的, 隐藏的;vt. 使整洁干净, 使紧身, 隐藏

examples.en: The children sat snug under blankets watching the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子们裹着毯子,暖暖和和地看雪。

meaning: n. 毒液, 恶意;vt. 放毒, 使有毒

examples.en: Researchers milk snake venom to develop new medicines.
examples.zh: 研究人员采集蛇毒以研发新药。

meaning: n. 破坏, 蹂躏;v. 毁坏, 破坏, 掠夺

examples.en: Wildfires ravage the dry hills almost every summer now.
examples.zh: 如今几乎每年夏天野火都肆虐干燥的山丘。

meaning: vt. 战胜, 超越, 克服

examples.en: With tutoring, she managed to surmount her fear of mathematics.
examples.zh: 通过辅导,她克服了对数学的恐惧。

meaning: a. 炽燃的, 强烈的

examples.en: They escaped the blazing building through a rear fire exit.
examples.zh: 他们从后部的消防通道逃出熊熊燃烧的大楼。

meaning: n. 喧闹, 叫嚷, 大声的要求;v. 喧嚷, 大声地要求

examples.en: Public clamor forced the city to reopen the closed pool.
examples.zh: 公众的强烈呼声迫使市府重开泳池。

meaning: n. 喧闹, 裙撑;vi. 奔忙, 喧闹

examples.en: She enjoys the bustle of the market on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 她喜欢周六早晨市场的热闹。

meaning: vt. 滴注, 慢慢地灌输

examples.en: Coaches try to instill discipline in every new recruit.
examples.zh: 教练努力向每名新队员灌输纪律意识。

meaning: vt. 弄乱, 使混乱, 使脱去衣服;n. 无秩序, 杂乱, 不整齐的衣着

examples.en: The sudden resignation left the party in complete disarray.
examples.zh: 突然的辞职让该党陷入全面混乱。

meaning: n. 观察, 遵守, 仪式, 风俗习惯;遵守, 奉行, 惯例

examples.en: The festival is an observance of the town's founding charter.
examples.zh: 这个节日是对小镇建镇宪章的纪念。

meaning: v. 雕刻, 造型

examples.en: The artist chose to sculpt the mayor from white marble.
examples.zh: 艺术家选择用白色大理石雕刻市长像。

meaning: vt. 刻上, 雕刻, 铭记

examples.en: Craftsmen engrave the winner's name on the silver trophy.
examples.zh: 工匠把获胜者的名字刻在银杯上。

meaning: a. 不能想象的, 不可思议的

examples.en: Losing the entire harvest overnight seemed unimaginable to the farmers.
examples.zh: 一夜之间失去全部收成,这在农民看来不可想象。

meaning: n. 悬疑, 焦虑, 悬念, 悬而不决;未定, 暂记

examples.en: The film builds suspense right up to the final scene.
examples.zh: 影片的悬念一直保持到最后一幕。

meaning: n. 哈罗公学, 耙;vt. 耙掘, 伤害, 使苦恼

examples.en: The farmer dragged a heavy harrow across the field to break the soil.
examples.zh: 农夫拖着沉重的耙穿过田地松土。

meaning: n. 杂乱;vt. 弄乱, 使凌乱

examples.en: Old receipts began to clutter every drawer in the office.
examples.zh: 旧收据渐渐塞满办公室的每个抽屉。

meaning: vt. 伪装, 掩饰;n. 伪装, 伪装物, 幌子

examples.en: Soldiers wore camouflage to blend into the autumn woodland.
examples.zh: 士兵身穿迷彩,与秋日林地融为一体。

meaning: n. 野蛮人;a. 野蛮的

examples.en: Roman writers portrayed every outsider as a barbarian.
examples.zh: 罗马作家把一切外来者都描写成蛮族。

meaning: a. 不流动的, 停滞的, 不景气的, 萧条的, 污浊的, 迟钝的;萧条的

examples.en: Sales remained stagnant despite the expensive advertising campaign.
examples.zh: 尽管广告投入巨大,销售依然停滞。

meaning: v. (使)流出, (使)渗出

examples.en: The mentor seems to exude confidence before every major pitch.
examples.zh: 导师在每次重要提案前都显得信心十足。

meaning: n. 互相依赖

examples.en: The pandemic revealed the interdependence of global supply chains.
examples.zh: 疫情揭示了全球供应链的相互依存。

meaning: n. 镁;镁Mg

examples.en: Green vegetables are a good dietary source of magnesium.
examples.zh: 绿叶蔬菜是膳食中镁的良好来源。

meaning: adv. 用手

examples.en: The clerks had to enter each record manually for weeks.
examples.zh: 数周以来,职员不得不手动录入每条记录。

meaning: n. 深红色;a. 深红色的

examples.en: The maples turned crimson just before the first frost.
examples.zh: 初霜之前,枫叶变成了绯红色。

meaning: a. 迁移的, 流浪的

examples.en: The wetland shelters migratory birds traveling between two continents.
examples.zh: 这片湿地庇护往返于两大洲之间的候鸟。

meaning: n. 韵律, 抑扬, 调子, 节奏;步调

examples.en: The rowers matched their strokes to the coxswain's steady cadence.
examples.zh: 桨手们把划桨节奏对准舵手稳定的拍子。

meaning: n. 十字形;a. 十字形的

examples.en: Ancient trade routes crisscross the desert north of the oasis.
examples.zh: 古商路在绿洲以北的沙漠中纵横交错。

meaning: a. 不宜的, 不顺利的, 反对的;不利的, 有害的, 不吉祥的

examples.en: Unfavorable weather delayed the launch for the third time.
examples.zh: 不利的天气第三次推迟了发射。

meaning: vt. 隐秘, 隐藏, 隐匿, 分泌;分泌

examples.en: Certain glands secrete hormones directly into the bloodstream.
examples.zh: 某些腺体直接向血液分泌激素。

meaning: a. 快乐的, 高兴的

examples.en: The streets erupted in joyous celebration after the final whistle.
examples.zh: 终场哨响之后,街头爆发欢乐的庆祝。

meaning: a. 有效用的, 实利主义的, 功利主义的;n. 功利主义者

examples.en: The school's architecture is utilitarian rather than beautiful.
examples.zh: 学校建筑重实用而不重美观。

meaning: n. 箩, 筐, 急速逃走, 天窗, 小舱口;vi. 急速逃走, 急忙撤退

examples.en: Crabs scuttle sideways across the sand as the tide recedes.
examples.zh: 退潮时,螃蟹在沙上横行疾走。

meaning: n. 吱吱声, 侥幸;vi. 吱吱叫, 告密, 侥幸成功

examples.en: The old floorboards squeak whenever anyone walks upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼上只要有人走动,旧地板就吱吱作响。

meaning: n. 棒, 棍, 杖

examples.en: The magician waved his wand and the doves disappeared.
examples.zh: 魔术师挥动魔杖,鸽子随即消失。

meaning: n. 壕沟, 护城河;vt. 将...围以壕沟

examples.en: A deep moat once protected the castle from attackers.
examples.zh: 深深的护城河曾保护城堡抵御进攻者。

meaning: n. 全盛期;interj. 嘿

examples.en: In its heyday, the port handled half the country's trade.
examples.zh: 港口鼎盛时期处理全国一半的贸易。

meaning: a. 常出现鬼的, 闹鬼的

examples.en: Local legend says the lighthouse is haunted by its last keeper.
examples.zh: 当地传说灯塔里住着最后一任守塔人的鬼魂。

meaning: n. 坚硬, 困难, 严厉, 勇气;硬度

examples.en: Diamond's extreme hardness makes it ideal for cutting tools.
examples.zh: 钻石极高的硬度使其成为理想的刀具材料。

meaning: n. 终点, 界标, 终点站;界标, 界牌, 界石

examples.en: The old rail terminus has become a lively food market.
examples.zh: 老铁路终点站已变成热闹的美食市场。

meaning: n. 长处, 特长, 拿手, 优点

examples.en: Public speaking was never her forte, so she practiced daily.
examples.zh: 演讲从来不是她的强项,于是她天天练习。

meaning: a. 自以为是的, 自鸣得意的, 整洁的;n. 书呆子, 自命不凡的家伙

examples.en: His smug smile annoyed everyone who had lost money.
examples.zh: 他那自鸣得意的微笑惹恼了所有亏钱的人。

meaning: n. 努力, 发挥, 运用;劳力, 用力

examples.en: After the exertion of the climb, they rested by the stream.
examples.zh: 爬山耗尽力气之后,他们在溪边休息。

meaning: a. 微红的, 略带红色的

examples.en: The soil's reddish color signals a high iron content.
examples.zh: 土壤偏红的颜色表明含铁量很高。

meaning: n. 共谋, 勾结;勾结, 串通, 串同舞弊

examples.en: The regulators accused the two firms of collusion over prices.
examples.zh: 监管机构指控两家公司在价格上串通一气。

meaning: a. 品德高尚的, 公正的, 贞洁的, 有效力的

examples.en: The play portrays a virtuous merchant tested by easy temptation.
examples.zh: 剧中一位正直的商人经受住了唾手可得的诱惑。

meaning: vi. 流产, 中途失败;vt. 使流产, 使失败, 使中止

examples.en: Mission control decided to abort the launch with seconds remaining.
examples.zh: 离发射只剩几秒时,控制中心决定中止任务。

meaning: vt. 调合, 捏造, 编造;调制, 混合

examples.en: The children concoct a strange drink from juice and spices.
examples.zh: 孩子们用果汁和香料调制出一种奇怪的饮料。

meaning: n. 工业化, 产业化;工业化

examples.en: Rapid industrialization transformed the valley within a single generation.
examples.zh: 快速的工业化在一代人之内改变了这条山谷。

meaning: a. 费力的, 努力的, 险峻的

examples.en: The arduous trek to the base camp took five days.
examples.zh: 前往大本营的艰辛跋涉花了五天。

meaning: a. 有益健康的, 使人健康的, 卫生的;有益健康的, 健康的, 卫生的

examples.en: The program promotes healthful eating habits among young children.
examples.zh: 该项目促进幼儿养成有益健康的饮食习惯。

meaning: vt. 下狱, 监禁, 禁闭;监禁, 使下狱, 禁闭

examples.en: The state moved to incarcerate repeat offenders for longer terms.
examples.zh: 该州采取行动,延长对累犯的监禁。

meaning: n. 玉蜀黍, 黄色;a. 玉蜀黍色的, 黄色的

examples.en: Farmers store dried maize in metal silos after the harvest.
examples.zh: 收获之后,农民把干玉米存进金属粮仓。

meaning: n. 异端, 异教;异端邪说, 异教, 信奉异教

examples.en: Medieval scholars risked heresy charges for questioning official doctrine.
examples.zh: 中世纪学者质疑官方教义便有被指为异端的危险。

meaning: n. 松柏目植物, 针叶树

examples.en: Each conifer keeps its needles through the coldest months.
examples.zh: 每棵针叶树在最冷的月份也不落针叶。

meaning: n. 打火石, 燧石, 极硬的东西;燧石

examples.en: Early hunters struck sparks from flint to start their fires.
examples.zh: 早期猎人敲击燧石取火。

meaning: n. 声明, 格言, 法官意见;宣言, 声明, 法官的意见

examples.en: The judge's famous dictum is quoted in every law school.
examples.zh: 这位法官的名言在每所法学院都被引用。

meaning: a. 闪烁的, 摇曳的, 微弱的;闪烁

examples.en: A flickering candle lit the long corridor of the inn.
examples.zh: 一支摇曳的蜡烛照亮客栈的长廊。

meaning: a. 不规则的, 反常的;异常的, 反常的

examples.en: The sensor flagged an anomalous reading during the reactor test.
examples.zh: 反应堆测试中,传感器标出一处异常读数。

meaning: v. (使)集合, (使)聚集;a. 集合在一起的, 集体的

examples.en: Fans congregate outside the stadium hours before the concert begins.
examples.zh: 演唱会开始前几小时,歌迷就聚集在体育场外。

meaning: adv. 在高处, 在上

examples.en: The crowd held banners aloft as the team bus arrived.
examples.zh: 球队大巴抵达时,人群把横幅高高举起。

meaning: n. 流行性感冒;流行性感冒, 流感

examples.en: The influenza outbreak closed three schools in the district.
examples.zh: 流感的暴发导致该区三所学校停课。

meaning: n. 制定, 条例, 法规, 法令, 颁布, 规定;制定, 规定, 颁布

examples.en: The enactment of the new law took nearly two years.
examples.zh: 这部新法律的颁布历时近两年。

meaning: a. 令人昏乱的；极快的；灿烂的

examples.en: The trail climbs at a dizzying rate above the treeline.
examples.zh: 小径在林线之上以令人目眩的坡度爬升。

meaning: vi. 回响, 反响, 被反射;vt. 使反响, 使回响, 反射

examples.en: The drumbeats seemed to reverberate through the entire canyon.
examples.zh: 鼓声仿佛回荡在整个峡谷之中。

meaning: vt. 修饰, 装饰, 润色

examples.en: Grandmothers often embellish family stories with each retelling.
examples.zh: 祖母们每讲一次家史,都要添油加醋。

meaning: n. 无神论者

examples.en: The writer, a committed atheist, debated the priest on stage.
examples.zh: 这位坚定的无神论作家与神父同台辩论。

meaning: vt.vi. 使空出, 搬出, 腾出, 不再使用/居住, 解除(职位), 撤离(阵地), 辞职, 退位;vt. 取消, 使作废

examples.en: Guests must vacate their rooms before eleven in the morning.
examples.zh: 客人须在上午十一点前退房。

meaning: a. 闪耀的, 炫目的, 瞪视的

examples.en: The report contains a glaring error in its opening statistics.
examples.zh: 报告开篇的统计数据存在明显错误。

meaning: a. 熔化的, 炽热的, 铸造的;melt的过去分词

examples.en: Molten rock flowed slowly down the volcano's northern flank.
examples.zh: 熔岩沿火山北坡缓缓流下。

meaning: n. 鞘, 叶鞘, 翅鞘;护套

examples.en: The sword slid back into its decorated leather sheath.
examples.zh: 长剑滑回装饰华丽的皮鞘。

meaning: n. 笔记本, 钱袋, 皮夹, 经济来源

examples.en: Rising fuel prices hit every family's pocketbook this winter.
examples.zh: 今冬燃油价格上涨让每个家庭的钱包吃紧。

meaning: a. 游牧的, 游牧生活的, 流浪的;游动的, 无定的, 游离的

examples.en: The nomadic herders move their flocks with the seasons.
examples.zh: 游牧民随着季节迁徙畜群。

meaning: vt. 迷住, 迷惑

examples.en: The storyteller could captivate a room full of restless children.
examples.zh: 讲故事的人能让满屋好动的孩子听得入迷。

meaning: n. 角落, 躲蔽处, 隐匿处, 凹处

examples.en: She turned the window nook into a small reading corner.
examples.zh: 她把窗边的角落改成小小的读书角。

meaning: n. 皱褶, 波纹, 生气, 混乱;vt. 弄皱, 触怒, 洗(牌), 连续轻擂(鼓)

examples.en: The evening breeze began to ruffle the tablecloth on the terrace.
examples.zh: 晚风轻拂,吹动了露台上的桌布。

meaning: a. 添加的, 附加的, 加法的, 累积的;n. 添加物

examples.en: The label lists every additive contained in the snack.
examples.zh: 标签上列出了零食所含的全部添加剂。

meaning: a. 可察觉的, 易发现的;可检测的

examples.en: The leak was barely detectable without special measuring equipment.
examples.zh: 没有专门测量设备几乎检测不到泄漏。

meaning: n. 散布, 传播, 分散

examples.en: Wind patterns govern the dispersal of seeds across the plain.
examples.zh: 风的模式决定种子在平原上的散布。

meaning: n. 厌恶, 讨厌的事, 讨厌的人;厌恶, 移转, 移位

examples.en: He never hid his aversion to crowded shopping malls.
examples.zh: 他从不掩饰对拥挤商场的反感。

meaning: n. 年代学, 资料按年月次序的排列, 按时间顺序编制的表格, 年表

examples.en: The archive established a precise chronology of the ancient kings.
examples.zh: 这份档案确立了古代诸王的精确年表。

meaning: vi. 合并, 联合, 合生;结合

examples.en: The small parties coalesced into a single opposition movement.
examples.zh: 各小党合并成一个统一的反对派运动。

meaning: a. 透明的；水晶般的；水晶制的

examples.en: The hikers filled their bottles from a crystalline mountain spring.
examples.zh: 徒步者从清澈的山泉灌满水壶。

meaning: a. 巨大的, 巨像似的

examples.en: A colossal statue of the founder guards the city gate.
examples.zh: 巨大的奠基人雕像守望着城门。

meaning: a. 无效力的, 无效的, 无价值的;n. 零, 空, 零位

examples.en: The court declared the election result null and ordered a rerun.
examples.zh: 法院宣布选举结果无效,下令重新选举。

meaning: a. 被压缩的, 扁平的

examples.en: The lecture was compressed into two intensive weekend sessions.
examples.zh: 讲座被压缩为两个密集的周末课时。

meaning: n. 狍, 鱼子, 鱼卵;鱼卵, 牝鹿

examples.en: The chef garnished the sushi with bright orange roe.
examples.zh: 主厨用橙亮的鱼籽点缀寿司。

meaning: a. 异种的, 异质的, 由不同成分形成的;不均匀的, 多相的, 异质的

examples.en: The city's population is remarkably heterogeneous in language and faith.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口在语言和信仰上极为多元。

meaning: n. 计算, 计数, 计算结果;计算, 估计, 计算法

examples.en: The complex computation took the supercomputer three full days.
examples.zh: 这项复杂计算让超级计算机跑了整整三天。

meaning: vt. 设要塞于, 加强, 使坚强, 增加;vi. 筑防御工事

examples.en: Engineers fortify the riverbank with stone before the monsoon season.
examples.zh: 工程师在雨季前用石料加固河岸。

meaning: n. 垂饰, 下垂物, 补充的东西, 补编;垂环

examples.en: She wears a silver pendant that her grandmother left her.
examples.zh: 她戴着祖母留下的一枚银吊坠。

meaning: a. 危险的, 濒临毁灭的

examples.en: The refugees faced a perilous crossing through the mountain pass.
examples.zh: 难民们要面对穿越山口的艰险路程。

meaning: n. 树液, 体液, 活力, 坑道, 消弱, 警棍;vt. 使排出体液, 使伤元气, 使衰竭, 挖坑道逼近, 逐渐侵蚀

examples.en: Ice storms can sap the strength of young trees.
examples.zh: 冰暴常常会耗尽幼树的元气。

meaning: n. 遗赠物, 遗产, 遗赠;遗产

examples.en: The library was founded through a generous bequest from a merchant.
examples.zh: 这座图书馆靠一位商人的慷慨遗赠建成。

meaning: vt. 使惊骇, 使大惊

examples.en: The magician's final trick continued to astound even veteran critics.
examples.zh: 魔术师的最后一个戏法连资深评论家也为之惊叹。

meaning: vt. 使感染, 灌输, 使浸透

examples.en: Good teachers imbue their students with a love of learning.
examples.zh: 好老师让学生浸润在对学习的热爱之中。

meaning: n. (河流的)蜿蜒, 漫步, 迂回旅行;vi. 蜿蜒流动, 漫步

examples.en: The river meanders gently through the farmland toward the sea.
examples.zh: 河流缓缓蜿蜒穿过农田流向大海。

meaning: a. 慈悲的, 可怜的, 令人同情的, 可鄙的

examples.en: The refugees arrived in a pitiful state after weeks at sea.
examples.zh: 难民在海上漂流数周后抵达,境况凄惨。

meaning: n. 冲淡, 淡度, 稀度, 稀释物, 冲淡物, 稀释;稀释度的

examples.en: Investors worried about the dilution of their shares in the merger.
examples.zh: 投资者担心合并中股份遭到稀释。

meaning: vt. 发布, 公布, 发表, 传播;颁布, 公告, 散播

examples.en: The agency will promulgate new safety rules in the spring.
examples.zh: 该机构将于春季颁布新的安全规章。

meaning: n. 哨兵, 看守;vt. 设岗哨

examples.en: A lone sentry guarded the bridge through the freezing night.
examples.zh: 一名哨兵在严寒中通宵守卫大桥。

meaning: a. 冰的, 冰川的, 冰川时代的, 冰冷的;冰的, 冰样的

examples.en: The valley was carved by glacial ice over countless millennia.
examples.zh: 这条山谷由冰川在无数千年间侵蚀而成。

meaning: a. 不用语言的；不用动词的

examples.en: Interviewers notice nonverbal cues as much as spoken answers.
examples.zh: 面试官对非言语线索的留意不亚于口头回答。

meaning: n. 鸟类羽毛

examples.en: The male bird grows bright plumage only during mating season.
examples.zh: 雄鸟只在求偶季节长出艳丽羽毛。

meaning: n. 扩大, 放大;放大; 放大作用

examples.en: The guitar's amplification filled the small club with sound.
examples.zh: 吉他扩音的声音充满了小俱乐部。

meaning: a. 天生的, 先天的;先天的

examples.en: The clinic screens newborns for congenital heart problems.
examples.zh: 诊所为新生儿筛查先天性心脏问题。

meaning: n. 独奏者, 独唱者

examples.en: The young soloist performed a demanding violin concerto from memory.
examples.zh: 年轻的独奏者凭记忆演奏高难度小提琴协奏曲。

meaning: a. 沙哑的, 粗声的, 喧闹的

examples.en: Raucous laughter spilled from the pub onto the quiet street.
examples.zh: 酒馆里喧闹的笑声洒到了安静的街上。

meaning: n. 辅音;a. 一致的, 调和的

examples.en: The word ends with a harsh consonant that learners often drop.
examples.zh: 这个词以一个刺耳的辅音结尾,学习者常漏读。

meaning: n. 小滴;小滴

examples.en: Each droplet of dew caught the first light of dawn.
examples.zh: 每滴露珠都映着黎明的第一缕光。

meaning: a. 粘着的, 涂有粘性物质的;n. 粘合剂, 橡皮膏

examples.en: Use a strong adhesive to bond the tiles to the wall.
examples.zh: 用强力粘合剂把瓷砖贴到墙上。

meaning: vt. 激怒, 使暴怒

examples.en: The unfair verdict continued to enrage the entire neighborhood.
examples.zh: 不公正的判决让整个社区群情激愤。

meaning: n. 大提琴

examples.en: She carries her cello to lessons every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 每周六上午她都背着大提琴去上课。

meaning: n. 盲从, 偏见, 偏执的行为(或态度)

examples.en: The mayor spoke out against bigotry in her inauguration speech.
examples.zh: 市长在就职演说中公开反对偏执。

meaning: n. 页岩

examples.en: Drillers extract oil and gas from deep shale formations.
examples.zh: 钻井公司从深层页岩中开采石油和天然气。

meaning: n. 吉兆, 占卜, 赞助

examples.en: The concert series runs under the auspices of the city council.
examples.zh: 系列音乐会在市议会的主办下举行。

meaning: a. 毛皮的, 盖着毛皮的, 似毛皮的

examples.en: The children delighted in the zoo's furry residents.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢上动物园里毛茸茸的动物。

meaning: n. 缺席者, 不在者;缺勤者, 缺席者, 未到工者

examples.en: The school counselor called every absentee's home after the third day.
examples.zh: 第三天起,学校辅导员逐一给缺勤学生家里打电话。

meaning: a. 刺激性的, 尖刻的, 苦痛的;冲味的, 刺激味的

examples.en: A pungent smell of garlic filled the tiny kitchen.
examples.zh: 小厨房里弥漫着刺鼻的蒜味。

meaning: n. 富矿带, 带来好运的事物, 幸运

examples.en: The oil discovery proved a bonanza for the remote province.
examples.zh: 石油的发现成了偏远省份的一大财源。

meaning: n. 三部剧, 三部曲;三联, 三联症

examples.en: Her acclaimed fantasy trilogy concludes with a fierce naval battle.
examples.zh: 她广受好评的奇幻三部曲以激烈海战收尾。

meaning: n. 替罪羔羊, 替人顶罪者, 替身;替罪羊, 代人受过者

examples.en: The junior analyst became the scapegoat for the failed merger.
examples.zh: 初级分析师成了合并失败的替罪羊。

meaning: n. 地志, 地形学, 地势, 局部解剖学;局部解剖, 局部记载

examples.en: The map's contours capture the rugged topography of the highlands.
examples.zh: 地图的等高线展现出高地崎岖的地形。

meaning: n. 贝, 甲壳类水生物;牡蛎

examples.en: The bay's clean waters yield superb shellfish for local restaurants.
examples.zh: 海湾清洁的水域为当地餐馆提供上等贝类。

meaning: n. 横跨的一步, 台阶;vt. 横跨一步躲避, 回避

examples.en: The senator tried to sidestep questions about the leaked memo.
examples.zh: 参议员试图回避有关泄露备忘录的提问。

meaning: n. 雀科鸣鸟

examples.en: A bright yellow finch perched on the garden fence.
examples.zh: 一只鲜黄的雀鸟停在花园的栅栏上。

meaning: n. 畏缩, 后退, 弹回, 反作用, 后坐力;vi. 退却, 畏缩, 弹回, 撤退, 反冲, 报应

examples.en: The child would recoil whenever the loud buzzer sounded.
examples.zh: 每当蜂鸣器响起,那孩子就会吓得缩一下。

meaning: n. 酸性;酸度; 酸性; 酸性反应

examples.en: The wine's high acidity pairs well with rich seafood dishes.
examples.zh: 这种酒酸度高,与浓味海鲜相得益彰。

meaning: n. 集合, 聚合, 集合体;聚集; 聚集作用

examples.en: The website builds an aggregation of headlines from dozens of papers.
examples.zh: 该网站汇总数十家报纸的新闻标题。

meaning: n. 遗迹, 痕迹, 残余, 丝毫, 退化的器官;遗迹, 剩件, 剩余

examples.en: The ruined tower is the last vestige of the medieval castle.
examples.zh: 残塔是中世纪城堡最后的遗迹。

meaning: n. 鹌鹑;vi. 胆怯, 畏缩

examples.en: The quail hid in the tall grass beside the path.
examples.zh: 鹌鹑藏在路旁的高草丛里。

meaning: n. 形态学, 词法, 形态;形态学

examples.en: The course examines the morphology of words in several languages.
examples.zh: 该课程研究多种语言中词语的形态。

meaning: n. 厚度, 板层;vt. 使用, 使劲挥舞, 从事, 折, 弯

examples.en: Fishermen still ply the coastal waters in wooden boats.
examples.zh: 渔民仍乘木船在近海作业。

meaning: vi. 犯错, 做错, 犯罪;弄错, 犯错误, 陈述

examples.en: Doctors acknowledge that even careful surgeons can err under pressure.
examples.zh: 医生们承认,即使细心的外科医生在压力下也会出错。

meaning: vt. 欺骗, 哄骗, 愚弄;n. 愚弄人, 恶作剧

examples.en: The evacuation turned out to be an elaborate student hoax.
examples.zh: 疏散事件最后证实是学生精心策划的恶作剧。

meaning: n. 新闻广播

examples.en: The evening newscast led with the flood warnings upstate.
examples.zh: 晚间新闻以北部的洪灾警报作为头条。

meaning: a. 邻近的, 接近的;接触的

examples.en: The reserve protects a contiguous stretch of rainforest across two provinces.
examples.zh: 保护区守护着横跨两省连成一片的雨林。

meaning: n. 外表, 伪装, 假象, 少量

examples.en: The town kept up a semblance of normalcy through the crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间,小镇维持着表面的正常。

meaning: a. 原始的, 自原始时代的;原始的

examples.en: The scientists traced the primordial gases trapped deep within the ancient rock samples.
examples.zh: 科学家追溯了古老岩石样本深处蕴藏的原始气体。

meaning: a. 多刺的, 令人苦恼的

examples.en: The committee faced a thorny question about how to allocate the limited budget.
examples.zh: 委员会面临一个棘手的问题,即如何分配有限的预算。

meaning: vt. 把...装入箱内, 包住

examples.en: Workers encase the fragile artifacts in foam before shipping them to the museum.
examples.zh: 工人们将易碎文物封入泡沫,再运往博物馆。

meaning: n. 凝块, 一团;v. (使)凝结, (使)聚集

examples.en: Blood begins to clot within minutes once it leaves the vessel.
examples.zh: 血液一旦离开血管,几分钟内便开始凝结。

meaning: a. 滋养的, 营养的;有营养的

examples.en: Schools should offer nutritious meals so children can concentrate throughout the day.
examples.zh: 学校应提供营养丰富的餐食,让孩子全天保持专注。

meaning: n. 运输, 运输工具, 财产转让;运输工具, 转让证书, 财产的转让

examples.en: The old canal served as the main conveyance of coal before railways arrived.
examples.zh: 铁路出现之前,这条古运河是煤炭运输的主要途径。

meaning: n. 小书写体, 小写字;a. 用小书写体的, 小写字的

examples.en: The error was so minuscule that only a laser scanner could detect it.
examples.zh: 这个误差极其微小,只有激光扫描仪才能检测出来。

meaning: n. 碱;a. 碱性的

examples.en: Farmers add sulfur to soil that contains too much alkali for most crops.
examples.zh: 农民向碱性过强的土壤中添加硫磺,以利作物生长。

meaning: a. 和谐的, 音乐般的, 和声的;n. 泛音, 谐波

examples.en: The engineer adjusted the bridge design to reduce harmful harmonic vibrations in high wind.
examples.zh: 工程师调整了桥梁设计,以减少强风中有害的谐波振动。

meaning: n. 造币;造币, 货币制度

examples.en: The word 'blog' is a relatively recent coinage that spread within a few years.
examples.zh: blog这个新造的词在几年之间便流传开来。

meaning: n. 自携式水中呼吸器

examples.en: She obtained her scuba certification before joining the marine research team in Bali.
examples.zh: 她在加入巴厘岛海洋研究队之前考取了潜水证书。

meaning: n. 即席演出, 即兴曲;a. 即席的

examples.en: The mayor gave an impromptu speech to the crowd gathered outside city hall.
examples.zh: 市长向聚集在市政厅外的人群即兴发表了演讲。

meaning: a. 无限制的

examples.en: Unrestricted access to the archives let historians examine rare documents at will.
examples.zh: 历史学家可以不受限制地查阅档案中的珍稀文献。

meaning: a. 有旋律的, 旋律美妙的

examples.en: Her melodic voice made even the routine announcement sound pleasant.
examples.zh: 她旋律般悦耳的声音让例行的广播通知也变得动听。

meaning: n. 泻水坡, 风化;天然时效

examples.en: Centuries of weathering have smoothed the sharp edges of these granite columns.
examples.zh: 数百年的风化作用磨平了这些花岗岩柱的棱角。

meaning: a. 夜的, 夜曲的;夜间的

examples.en: Owls are nocturnal hunters that rely on hearing to locate prey in darkness.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰是夜行性猎手,依靠听觉在黑暗中定位猎物。

meaning: n. 炫耀, 飘扬;v. 炫耀, 飘扬

examples.en: He loved to flaunt his expensive watch at every office meeting.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在每次办公室会议上炫耀自己昂贵的手表。

meaning: n. 哺乳动物;a. 哺乳动物的

examples.en: Whales display typical mammalian traits, nursing their young with milk.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼表现出典型的哺乳动物特征,用乳汁哺育幼崽。

meaning: n. 倾斜, 斜面, 观点, 偏见, 歪曲;a. 倾斜的

examples.en: The reporter's article had a noticeable political slant that angered some readers.
examples.zh: 记者的文章带有明显的政治倾向,激怒了一些读者。

meaning: n. 舞蹈指导

examples.en: The choreographer spent weeks refining every movement in the opening dance sequence.
examples.zh: 编舞师花了数周打磨开场舞蹈中的每一个动作。

meaning: n. 打扮, 装束;vt. 打扮, 穿衣

examples.en: The chefs wore traditional white garb while preparing the formal banquet.
examples.zh: 厨师们穿着传统的白色服装准备正式宴会。

meaning: a. 多虫的;n. 双轮单座轻马车, 四轮单座马车

examples.en: Tourists rode a horse-drawn buggy through the narrow streets of the old town.
examples.zh: 游客们乘坐马车穿行于老城的狭窄街道。

meaning: vt. 施肥, 使丰饶, 使受精

examples.en: Farmers fertilize the fields in spring to ensure a strong harvest.
examples.zh: 农民在春天给田地施肥,以确保丰收。

meaning: n. 策略, 手段, (桥牌中的)飞牌;v. 用计谋处理, 出小牌

examples.en: She handled the tense negotiation with remarkable finesse and patience.
examples.zh: 她以高超的技巧和耐心处理了这场紧张的谈判。

meaning: n. 首字母缩拼词, 首字母组合词;字首组合词

examples.en: NASA is an acronym for the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
examples.zh: NASA是美国国家航空航天局的首字母缩写。

meaning: n. 警戒, 警觉, 失眠症;不眠症, 警醒症

examples.en: Constant vigilance is required to keep the network secure from attacks.
examples.zh: 只有时刻保持警惕,才能使网络免受攻击。

meaning: n. 煤油, 火油, 灯油;煤油

examples.en: The mountain family still lights their home with kerosene lamps at night.
examples.zh: 这户山区人家夜里仍用煤油灯照明。

meaning: n. 宝石商, 宝石匠, 珠宝商

examples.en: The jeweler examined the diamond under a magnifying glass before naming a price.
examples.zh: 珠宝商先用放大镜检查钻石,然后才开价。

meaning: n. 月桂树, 荣誉;vt. 使戴桂冠, 授予荣誉

examples.en: In ancient Greece, a laurel wreath honored victorious athletes and poets.
examples.zh: 在古希腊,月桂花环用来表彰获胜的运动员和诗人。

meaning: n. 同谋, 串通, 复杂;共谋, 共犯关系

examples.en: The investigation revealed the manager's complicity in the smuggling operation.
examples.zh: 调查揭示了这位经理在走私案中的共谋行为。

meaning: n. 脂类, 类脂物, 脂质;类脂; 脂质; 脂类

examples.en: The lab test measures lipid levels to assess the patient's heart risk.
examples.zh: 化验通过测量脂质水平来评估患者的心脏风险。

meaning: n. 淀粉, 浆糊, 刻板;vt. 浆硬

examples.en: Rice and potatoes are rich in starch, which the body converts to energy.
examples.zh: 大米和土豆富含淀粉,人体会将其转化为能量。

meaning: a. 使迷惑的, 把人难住的

examples.en: The sudden drop in sales remains puzzling despite weeks of analysis.
examples.zh: 尽管分析数周,销量的骤降仍令人费解。

meaning: a. 奇怪的, 稀奇的, 想像的

examples.en: Critics dismissed the proposal as a fanciful dream that lacked any realistic funding.
examples.zh: 批评者认为该提案只是异想天开,缺乏现实的资金支持。

meaning: n. 极端, 极点, 困境, 绝境;肢, 端

examples.en: The lighthouse stands at the northern extremity of the rugged peninsula.
examples.zh: 灯塔矗立在崎岖半岛的北端。

meaning: a. 多孔的, 有气孔的, 多孔性的, 能渗透的;多孔的

examples.en: The porous rock allows rainwater to seep into the underground reservoir.
examples.zh: 多孔岩石使雨水得以渗入地下蓄水层。

meaning: a. 人口多的, 人口稠密的

examples.en: Shanghai is one of the most populous cities in the world.
examples.zh: 上海是世界上人口最多的城市之一。

meaning: adv. 有系统地, 有方法地

examples.en: She methodically checked every entry against the original ledger before closing the accounts.
examples.zh: 她在结账前有条不紊地逐条核对原始账簿。

meaning: n. 裂缝;缝

examples.en: A tiny alpine flower grew from a crevice in the sheer cliff face.
examples.zh: 一朵小小的高山花从陡峭崖面的石缝中长出。

meaning: vt. 挥, 挥舞;n. 挥舞

examples.en: The suspect tried to brandish a weapon but was quickly subdued by officers.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人试图挥舞武器,但很快被警员制服。

meaning: n. 失泽, 失泽膜, 污点;vt. 使失去光泽, 玷污

examples.en: Salt air can quickly tarnish silver jewelry left on the beach towel.
examples.zh: 盐雾会让遗落在沙滩巾上的银饰迅速失去光泽。

meaning: n. 格言, 座右铭;格言, 准则, 原则

examples.en: Her favorite maxim is that practice makes perfect in every craft.
examples.zh: 她最喜欢的格言是无论什么技艺都能熟能生巧。

meaning: n. 寓言

examples.en: The novel works as an allegory of revolution and its broken promises.
examples.zh: 这部小说可以看作一部关于革命及其失信的寓言。

meaning: vt. 过大而不适于, 长得比...高(或大、快), 成长得不再具有...

examples.en: Children outgrow shoes so quickly that parents must buy new pairs each season.
examples.zh: 孩子们长个儿太快,父母每个季节都得买新鞋。

meaning: n. 礼貌, 规矩, 适当;专有权

examples.en: Questions of propriety surrounded the mayor's acceptance of such a lavish gift.
examples.zh: 市长收受如此奢华的礼物,引发了是否得体的质疑。

meaning: n. 苦恼, 折磨, 苦恼的事由

examples.en: Modern medicine has turned a once-deadly affliction into a manageable condition.
examples.zh: 现代医学已把一种曾经致命的顽疾变为可控的疾病。

meaning: a. 不结果的, 不长果实的, 无子的

examples.en: After a fruitless search for the keys, she called a locksmith for help.
examples.zh: 找钥匙无果之后,她打电话请锁匠帮忙。

meaning: n. 雕刻匠, 雕工, 切肉刀;雕刻器

examples.en: A skilled carver turned the block of walnut into a graceful swan.
examples.zh: 熟练的雕刻匠把胡桃木块雕成一只优雅的天鹅。

meaning: vt. 连根拔起, 根除

examples.en: The violent storm managed to uproot several century-old trees along the avenue.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把林荫道上几棵百年老树连根拔起。

meaning: vt. 泄露, 透露

examples.en: The company refused to divulge details of the merger before the official announcement.
examples.zh: 公司拒绝在官方公告之前透露合并的细节。

meaning: a. 使耗尽的, 使人筋疲力尽的;经验, 技巧, 穷举, 耗尽, 排气

examples.en: The exhausting hike to the summit took nearly eleven hours in the heat.
examples.zh: 酷热中登顶的徒步近十一个小时,令人筋疲力尽。

meaning: vi. 侵犯, 侵蚀, 蚕食;侵犯, 侵入, 侵占

examples.en: New housing developments steadily encroach on the wetlands that birds depend upon.
examples.zh: 新的住宅开发不断蚕食鸟类赖以生存的湿地。

meaning: n. 音乐剧, 传奇剧, 戏剧似的事件

examples.en: What began as a simple disagreement turned into an office melodrama by Friday.
examples.zh: 一场简单的分歧到周五竟演变成办公室的闹剧。

meaning: a. 无道德原则的, 不审慎的, 肆无忌惮的

examples.en: Unscrupulous dealers sold forged paintings to collectors who never suspected a thing.
examples.zh: 无良商人把赝品画作卖给毫无戒心的收藏家。

meaning: a. 有波浪的, 多浪的, 波浪状的, 波动的, 不稳定的

examples.en: The artist painted wavy lines to suggest wind moving across the wheat field.
examples.zh: 画家用波浪状的线条表现风吹过麦田。

meaning: vt. 围攻, 包围

examples.en: Reporters would besiege the celebrity whenever she appeared in public with her family.
examples.zh: 每当这位名人携家人公开露面,记者都会团团围住她。

meaning: vt. 混合, 使微醉, 使咬字不清晰;vi. 胡乱对付

examples.en: Too many last-minute changes will muddle the schedule and confuse the staff.
examples.zh: 过多的临时变动会搞乱日程,让员工困惑。

meaning: vt. 刺绣, 镶边, 装饰;vi. 绣花

examples.en: My grandmother would embroider delicate flowers on the corners of linen tablecloths.
examples.zh: 祖母常在亚麻桌布的角上绣上精美的花朵。

meaning: n. 远见, 深谋远虑;先见, 预见, 预见的能力

examples.en: Their foresight in building the reservoir saved the city during the long drought.
examples.zh: 他们在修建水库上的远见使城市安然度过漫长的干旱。

meaning: n. 辛苦, 苦心, 工夫;a. 辛苦的, 勤勉的, 小心的

examples.en: Restoring the fresco required painstaking work by a team of patient experts.
examples.zh: 修复壁画需要一组耐心的专家进行艰苦细致的工作。

meaning: a. 可容忍的, 可以的

examples.en: Summer heat in the coastal town is tolerable thanks to constant sea breezes.
examples.zh: 常年不断的海风让海滨小镇的夏日暑热尚可忍受。

meaning: adv. 公正地, 理由充分地, 正当地

examples.en: The court justly awarded compensation to the workers who had been underpaid.
examples.zh: 法院公正地裁定向受欠薪的工人发放补偿。

meaning: a. 不屈曲的, 不屈挠的, 顽固的

examples.en: The manager's inflexible schedule left no room for family emergencies.
examples.zh: 经理僵硬的时间安排完全没有为家庭急事留出余地。

meaning: vt. 刺穿, 使呆住, 使固定;贯穿, 刺通

examples.en: Crowds stood transfixed as the solar eclipse darkened the afternoon sky.
examples.zh: 日食使午后天空变暗时,人群驻足凝望,看得入了迷。

meaning: a. 田园诗的, 牧歌的, 悠闲的

examples.en: They spent an idyllic summer in a cottage beside the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 他们在宁静的湖边小屋度过了一个田园诗般的夏天。

meaning: n. 惊愕, 恐怖, 惊惶失措

examples.en: To the consternation of shareholders, the quarterly report revealed heavy losses.
examples.zh: 季度报告披露巨额亏损,令股东大为惊愕。

meaning: n. 背叛, 缺乏, 毛病;缺点, 过失, 背叛

examples.en: The party suffered a major defection when its finance spokesperson joined the opposition.
examples.zh: 该党遭遇重大倒戈,财政发言人转投了反对党。

meaning: n. 不信任, 疑惑;v. 不信任, 疑惑

examples.en: Years of broken promises deepened the mistrust between the two neighboring states.
examples.zh: 多年的失信加深了两个邻国之间的不信任。

meaning: vt. 嘲笑, 愚弄;vi. 表示轻蔑

examples.en: Some drivers still flout the new speed limits despite heavier fines.
examples.zh: 尽管罚款加重,一些司机仍然无视新的限速规定。

meaning: a. 触觉的, 有触觉的;触觉的

examples.en: The museum offers tactile exhibits so blind visitors can experience the sculptures.
examples.zh: 博物馆提供可触摸展品,让视障观众也能感受雕塑。

meaning: a. 远离的, 冷淡的;adv. 远离, 冷漠超然地

examples.en: The new director remained aloof and rarely joined the team for lunch.
examples.zh: 新主管显得冷漠疏离,很少与团队一起吃午饭。

meaning: n. 驼背, 圆形隆起物, 鸵峰;vi. 隆起, 急速行进, 努力

examples.en: The camel stores fat in its hump to survive long desert journeys.
examples.zh: 骆驼在驼峰中储存脂肪,以熬过漫长的沙漠旅程。

meaning: n. 信任, 祭器台, 供桌, 凭证;设计人, 创立人, 创设人

examples.en: The leaked documents lent credence to rumors of secret price fixing.
examples.zh: 泄露的文件使操纵价格的传闻更可信了。

meaning: a. 味道差的, 使人不愉快的, 讨厌的

examples.en: Many viewers found the commercial distasteful and demanded its removal from television.
examples.zh: 许多观众认为该广告令人反感,要求将其撤下电视。

meaning: adv. 直率地, 直接地, 马上, 立即;a. 直接的, 直率的, 坦白的

examples.en: Her forthright criticism of the plan surprised everyone at the board meeting.
examples.zh: 她对该计划直率的批评让董事会上的每个人都很意外。

meaning: n. 毛毯, 毡;vt. 制毡, 使粘结

examples.en: The craft teacher cut bright shapes from soft felt for the children's puppets.
examples.zh: 手工老师从软毡布上剪下鲜艳的图形,给孩子们做玩偶。

meaning: a. 无比的, 无双的, 空前的

examples.en: The archive offers unparalleled access to manuscripts from the twelfth century.
examples.zh: 这家档案馆让人可以接触十二世纪的手稿,机会无与伦比。

meaning: n. 敲打, 碰撞, 叩击, 叩诊, 击发, 打击, 打击乐器组;叩诊

examples.en: The marching band's percussion section set the pace for the entire parade.
examples.zh: 仪仗队的打击乐声部为整个游行队伍定下节奏。

meaning: a. 不适当的, 不理智的, 笨拙的;不称职者, 无能的, 不符要求的

examples.en: The inept handling of customer complaints damaged the airline's reputation.
examples.zh: 对客户投诉的拙劣处理损害了航空公司的声誉。

meaning: n. 狂热, 大流行;v. (使)发狂, (使)开裂

examples.en: The fitness craze for step counting spread through offices within a single summer.
examples.zh: 计步健身的热潮仅在一个夏天内就席卷了各办公室。

meaning: a. 能适应的, 适合的, 可修改的

examples.en: Cacti are highly adaptable plants that survive in harsh desert conditions.
examples.zh: 仙人掌是适应力极强的植物,能在恶劣的沙漠环境中生存。

meaning: a. 充满激情的, 狂热的, 热烈的

examples.en: She delivered an impassioned plea for funding the local food bank.
examples.zh: 她慷慨激昂地呼吁为当地食物银行提供资金。

meaning: n. 马的缓行步态, 缓行漫步;vi. 马缓行, 从容漫步

examples.en: Couples amble along the seawall in the cool of the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚凉爽时分,情侣们沿着海堤悠闲漫步。

meaning: a. 在外的, 边远的, 偏僻的, 题外的

examples.en: Buses reach the outlying villages only twice a day during winter.
examples.zh: 冬季公交每天只有两班开往偏远的村庄。

meaning: n. 新, 新鲜, 精神饱满

examples.en: The freshness of the ingredients explains why the simple dish tastes so good.
examples.zh: 食材新鲜正是这道简单菜肴美味的原因。

meaning: n. 最后通牒, 基本原理;最后通牒, 哀的美敦书, 最后结论

examples.en: The union issued an ultimatum: raise wages by June or face a strike.
examples.zh: 工会发出最后通牒:六月前加薪,否则罢工。

meaning: a. 苛求的, 吃力的

examples.en: Restoring antique clocks is exacting work that demands years of training.
examples.zh: 修复古董钟表是要求极高的工作,需要多年训练。

meaning: n. 绿松石, 绿松石色

examples.en: The lake glowed a striking turquoise under the midday mountain sun.
examples.zh: 正午的高山阳光下,湖水泛着耀眼的绿松石色。

meaning: vt. 编成法典;使成文法化, 编成法典, 编纂

examples.en: The commission worked to codify the informal rules that had governed trade for generations.
examples.zh: 委员会致力于把世代沿用的非正式贸易规则编成法典。

meaning: n. 自我中心, 利己主义, 任性

examples.en: His selfishness in hoarding supplies angered everyone else in the shelter.
examples.zh: 他囤积物资的自私行为激怒了避难所里的其他人。

meaning: a. 热的, 炎热的, 热心的

examples.en: She remained a fervent supporter of the library even after moving abroad.
examples.zh: 即使移居国外,她仍是图书馆的热心支持者。

meaning: a. 圆胖的

examples.en: The chubby toddler chased pigeons happily across the sunny plaza.
examples.zh: 圆嘟嘟的幼儿在阳光明媚的广场上开心地追鸽子。

meaning: a. 非决定性的, 无效果的, 不得要领的;非决定性的, 不确定的, 无结果的

examples.en: The first round of blood tests came back inconclusive and had to be repeated.
examples.zh: 第一轮血液检测结果不明确,不得不重新检测。

meaning: a. 愿意, 倾向于

examples.en: The hospital disposed of expired medicines according to strict safety regulations.
examples.zh: 医院按照严格的安全规定处理过期药品。

meaning: a. 温顺的, 逆来顺受的

examples.en: His meek response to the insult surprised his outspoken friends.
examples.zh: 他对侮辱的温顺反应让心直口快的朋友们很吃惊。

meaning: n. 不幸之事, 灾祸, 恶运

examples.en: A minor mishap with the printer delayed the report by an hour.
examples.zh: 打印机的小故障使报告推迟了一小时。

meaning: n. 子孙, 后裔;子嗣, 后代, 后裔

examples.en: The archivists digitized the letters so that posterity could read them.
examples.zh: 档案员把信件数字化,以便后人能够阅读。

meaning: n. 成就, 实现, 结果实

examples.en: After five years of work, the restoration project finally came to fruition.
examples.zh: 历时五年的修复项目终于开花结果。

meaning: v. 详细说明, 解释

examples.en: The professor would expound on economic theory until even keen students grew restless.
examples.zh: 教授滔滔不绝地阐述经济理论,连好学的学生都坐不住了。

meaning: n. 变形, 弯曲, 歪曲, 乖僻, 偏差, 偏见;vt. 使变形, 弄歪, 使翘曲, 使不正常, 歪曲, 使有偏见

examples.en: High humidity can warp wooden floors and antique furniture.
examples.zh: 湿度过高会使木地板和古董家具翘曲变形。

meaning: n. 嗡嗡作声的东西, 蜂音器;蜂鸣器; 磨轮; 砂轮

examples.en: The quiz contestant hit the buzzer a second before her rival.
examples.zh: 智力竞赛选手比对手早一秒按下了抢答器。

meaning: n. 嫁接, 贪污;v. 嫁接, 移植, 贪污

examples.en: Gardeners graft branches from prized apple trees onto hardier rootstock each spring.
examples.zh: 园丁每年春天把名贵苹果树的枝条嫁接到更强健的砧木上。

meaning: a. 狂热的, 盲信的

examples.en: He was so fanatical about punctuality that he arrived an hour early everywhere.
examples.zh: 他对守时近乎狂热,到哪儿都提前一小时。

meaning: n. 周围环境, 气氛

examples.en: Soft lighting and quiet jazz gave the small cafe a relaxed ambience.
examples.zh: 柔和的灯光和轻缓的爵士乐让这家小咖啡馆氛围轻松。

meaning: a. 可理解的

examples.en: The coach's clear diagrams made the complex play comprehensible to every rookie.
examples.zh: 教练清晰的示意图让复杂战术在每个新人看来都易懂。

meaning: vt. 校对, 校勘;整理

examples.en: Volunteers helped collate the survey responses before the analysts began their work.
examples.zh: 志愿者帮助整理问卷答案,分析员随后开始工作。

meaning: a. 奢侈的, 华丽的

examples.en: The wedding banquet featured a sumptuous spread of seafood and regional delicacies.
examples.zh: 婚宴摆上了丰盛的海鲜和地方美食。

meaning: a. 有害的, 有毒的, 使道德败坏的;有害的, 有毒的

examples.en: Firefighters wore masks to protect against noxious fumes inside the burning warehouse.
examples.zh: 消防员戴上防毒面具,以免吸入燃烧仓库里的有毒烟气。

meaning: a. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暂的;暂时的

examples.en: Cherry blossoms are ephemeral, which is exactly why crowds cherish them each spring.
examples.zh: 樱花转瞬即逝,这也正是人们每年春天格外珍惜的原因。

meaning: a. 不足以令人相信的
